Words.Meaning: n. 和解；调和；和谐一致；n. （会计）对账；账目调整

Examples.English: The reconciliation between the two nations took decades of diplomacy.
Examples.Chinese: 两国的和解经历了数十年的外交努力。

Examples.English: Monthly bank reconciliation helps detect accounting errors.
Examples.Chinese: 每月银行对账有助于发现会计错误。

Examples.English: Her art explores the reconciliation of tradition and modernity.
Examples.Chinese: 她的作品探讨传统与现代的调和。

Words.Meaning: vt. 恢复（健康、意识等）；重新获得；vi. 痊愈；复原

Senses.Definition: 恢复（健康、意识等）；重新获得

Examples.English: She needed time to recover from the surgery.
Examples.Chinese: 她需要时间从手术中恢复。

Examples.English: The team recovered the stolen artifacts.
Examples.Chinese: 团队找回了被盗的文物。

Examples.English: The economy is slowly recovering.
Examples.Chinese: 经济正在缓慢复苏。

Words.Meaning: n. 恢复（健康、状态等）；n. 追回，重新获得（丢失物）

Examples.English: She made a full recovery after the surgery.
Examples.Chinese: 她在手术后完全康复了。

Examples.English: The police announced the recovery of the stolen artwork.
Examples.Chinese: 警方宣布追回了被盗的艺术品。

Examples.English: Economic recovery depends on consumer confidence.
Examples.Chinese: 经济复苏取决于消费者信心。

Words.Meaning: n. 娱乐，消遣；n. （身体或精神的）放松活动

Examples.English: Hiking is my favorite form of recreation.
Examples.Chinese: 徒步是我最喜爱的休闲方式。

Examples.English: Reading provides both knowledge and recreation.
Examples.Chinese: 阅读既能获取知识，也是一种消遣。

Words.Meaning: adj. 长方形的；直角的

Examples.English: The room has a rectangular shape.
Examples.Chinese: 这个房间呈长方形。

Examples.English: She drew a rectangular box on the paper.
Examples.Chinese: 她在纸上画了一个长方形盒子。

Examples.English: The table is perfectly rectangular with sharp corners.
Examples.Chinese: 这张桌子是标准的长方形，棱角分明。

Words.Meaning: vt. 纠正，修正（错误或问题）；vt. （化学）精馏，提纯

Examples.English: The government promised to rectify the economic imbalance.
Examples.Chinese: 政府承诺纠正经济失衡。

Examples.English: This device can rectify alternating current to direct current.
Examples.Chinese: 该装置可将交流电整流为直流电。

Examples.English: She took steps to rectify the mistake in the report.
Examples.Chinese: 她采取措施修正了报告中的错误。

Words.Meaning: vi. 再次发生；重现；vi. （问题或困难）重新出现；vi. （记忆、想法等）反复出现

Examples.English: The same issue may recur if not properly addressed.
Examples.Chinese: 若不妥善解决，同样的问题可能再次出现。

Examples.English: Memories of her childhood often recur in her dreams.
Examples.Chinese: 童年的记忆常在她的梦中反复浮现。

Examples.English: This error pattern recurs every few months.
Examples.Chinese: 这种错误模式每隔几个月就会重现一次。

Words.Meaning: vt. 回收利用（废弃物）；n. 回收利用的过程或系统

Senses.Definition: 回收利用的过程或系统

Examples.English: We should recycle paper to save trees.
Examples.Chinese: 我们应该回收纸张以保护树木。

Examples.English: The city has improved its recycling program.
Examples.Chinese: 该市改进了垃圾回收计划。

Words.Meaning: adj. 多余的，过剩的；adj. （因人员过剩）被解雇的

Examples.English: The report was full of redundant information.
Examples.Chinese: 这份报告充斥着冗余信息。

Examples.English: Many workers were made redundant after the factory automation.
Examples.Chinese: 工厂自动化后，许多工人被裁员。

Examples.English: Avoid using redundant words in your essay.
Examples.Chinese: 写作时应避免赘词。

Words.Meaning: n. 卷轴；卷筒；纺车；vt. 卷；绕；使眩晕；vi. 踉跄；旋转；感到眩晕

Examples.English: She wound the thread onto the reel carefully.
Examples.Chinese: 她小心地把线绕到卷轴上。

Examples.English: The boxer reeled from the heavy blow.
Examples.Chinese: 拳击手因重击而踉跄后退。

Examples.English: The room seemed to reel after he stood up too quickly.
Examples.Chinese: 他起身太快后，房间仿佛在旋转。

Words.Meaning: n. 裁判员；仲裁者；vt. /vi. 担任裁判；仲裁

Examples.English: The referee blew the whistle to stop the game.
Examples.Chinese: 裁判吹哨中止了比赛。

Examples.English: She was asked to referee the academic dispute.
Examples.Chinese: 她被邀请为学术争端担任仲裁。

Examples.English: All complaints will be referred to our customer service referee.
Examples.Chinese: 所有投诉将提交至客户服务仲裁员处理。

Words.Meaning: n. 参考；提及；参考文献；vt. 引用；附参考资料

Examples.English: She included a reference to the latest research in her paper.
Examples.Chinese: 她在论文中引用了最新研究。

Examples.English: The librarian helped me find reference materials.
Examples.Chinese: 图书管理员帮我找到了参考资料。

Examples.English: He made a vague reference to his past achievements.
Examples.Chinese: 他含糊地提到了过去的成就。

Words.Meaning: n. 改革，改良；vt. 改革，改造；vi. 改过自新

Examples.English: The government plans to reform the education system.
Examples.Chinese: 政府计划改革教育体系。

Examples.English: He reformed his lifestyle after the health warning.
Examples.Chinese: 健康警告后，他彻底改变了生活方式。

Examples.English: Social reforms often face resistance from conservative groups.
Examples.Chinese: 社会改革常遭遇保守群体的阻力。

Words.Meaning: v. 克制；避免（做某事）；n. （诗歌或歌曲的）叠句，副歌

Examples.English: She refrained from commenting on the controversial topic.
Examples.Chinese: 她克制自己不去评论这个有争议的话题。

Examples.English: The choir sang the refrain with great enthusiasm.
Examples.Chinese: 合唱团热情地演唱了副歌部分。

Examples.English: Please refrain from smoking in this area.
Examples.Chinese: 请勿在此区域吸烟。

Words.Meaning: vt. 使恢复精力；刷新（页面/数据）；vi. 恢复精神；补充能量

Senses.Definition: 使恢复精力；刷新（页面/数据）

Examples.English: She drank lemonade to refresh herself after the long walk.
Examples.Chinese: 长途步行后，她喝了柠檬水恢复精神。

Examples.English: Press F5 to refresh the webpage for updated results.
Examples.Chinese: 按 F5 刷新网页以获取更新结果。

Examples.English: The rain refreshed the dry soil overnight.
Examples.Chinese: 雨水一夜之间让干涸的土壤恢复了生机。

Words.Meaning: n. 茶点；点心（尤指休息时的小食或饮料）；n. 恢复精力；焕发精神

Senses.Definition: 茶点；点心（尤指休息时的小食或饮料）

Examples.English: The hotel offers free refreshments in the lobby every afternoon.
Examples.Chinese: 酒店每天下午在大堂提供免费茶点。

Examples.English: A short walk in nature is the perfect refreshment for a tired mind.
Examples.Chinese: 在自然中短暂散步是疲惫心灵的完美恢复。

Examples.English: Volunteers served refreshments to the marathon runners at the checkpoint.
Examples.Chinese: 志愿者在检查站为马拉松选手提供点心。

Words.Meaning: n. 避难所；庇护；n. （心理或情感的）慰藉

Examples.English: The mountain village became a refuge for war survivors.
Examples.Chinese: 这座山村成了战争幸存者的避难所。

Examples.English: Books were her refuge from loneliness.
Examples.Chinese: 书籍是她逃离孤独的慰藉。

Examples.English: Wildlife refuges protect endangered species.
Examples.Chinese: 野生动物保护区保护濒危物种。

Words.Meaning: n. 退款；偿还金额；vt. 退还（钱款）；偿还

Examples.English: The store promised to refund the full amount if the product was defective.
Examples.Chinese: 商店承诺若商品有瑕疵将全额退款。

Examples.English: She requested a refund after canceling her flight ticket.
Examples.Chinese: 取消机票后，她申请了退款。

Examples.English: The company refunded all customers affected by the pricing error.
Examples.Chinese: 公司向受定价错误影响的所有顾客退款。

Words.Meaning: n. 拒绝；回绝；n. （优先）取舍权

Examples.English: His refusal to cooperate surprised everyone.
Examples.Chinese: 他拒绝合作让所有人感到意外。

Examples.English: She has the first refusal on the apartment if the sale falls through.
Examples.Chinese: 如果交易失败，她拥有这套公寓的优先购买权。

Examples.English: The refusal of the proposal led to further negotiations.
Examples.Chinese: 提案被拒后，双方展开了进一步谈判。

Words.Meaning: vt. 驳斥，反驳（论点或观点）；vt. 否认（指控或断言）

Examples.English: The scientist refuted the theory with solid experimental data.
Examples.Chinese: 科学家用扎实的实验数据驳斥了这一理论。

Examples.English: He refuted the accusation by presenting an alibi.
Examples.Chinese: 他通过提供不在场证明否认了指控。

Examples.English: Her essay effectively refutes common misconceptions about climate change.
Examples.Chinese: 她的文章有力反驳了关于气候变化的常见误解。

Words.Meaning: n. 政权，政治制度；n. （饮食、训练等的）规律体系

Examples.English: The new regime imposed strict economic reforms.
Examples.Chinese: 新政权实施了严格的经济改革。

Examples.English: She follows a strict skincare regime every morning.
Examples.Chinese: 她每天早晨遵循严格的护肤流程。

Examples.English: The athlete’s training regime includes two hours of cardio daily.
Examples.Chinese: 这位运动员的训练计划包括每天两小时的有氧运动。

Words.Meaning: n. 军团；团（军事单位）；vt. 严密管制；系统化管理

Examples.English: He served in a cavalry regiment during the war.
Examples.Chinese: 他在战争中服役于一个骑兵团。

Examples.English: Schools should not regiment children's creativity.
Examples.Chinese: 学校不应扼杀孩子的创造力。

Examples.English: The daily routine was rigidly regimented.
Examples.Chinese: 每日作息被严格规定。

Words.Meaning: n. 地区，区域（指地理或行政划分）；n. （身体的）部位；n. （学术、活动等的）领域

Senses.Definition: 地区，区域（指地理或行政划分）

Examples.English: The Amazon rainforest is a vital region for biodiversity.
Examples.Chinese: 亚马逊雨林是生物多样性的关键区域。

Examples.English: She felt pain in the abdominal region after the surgery.
Examples.Chinese: 手术后她的腹部区域感到疼痛。

Examples.English: His research focuses on the region of artificial intelligence ethics.
Examples.Chinese: 他的研究专注于人工智能伦理领域。

Words.Meaning: n. 登记簿；注册；记录器；vt. 登记；注册；记录；vi. 登记；注册

Examples.English: Please register your details at the front desk.
Examples.Chinese: 请在前台登记您的信息。

Examples.English: The thermometer registered a sudden drop in temperature.
Examples.Chinese: 温度计显示温度骤降。

Examples.English: Her name was struck off the electoral register.
Examples.Chinese: 她的名字被从选民名册中删除。

Words.Meaning: n. 规则，规章（官方制定的管理条款）；n. 调节，控制（保持系统稳定的过程）

Senses.Definition: 规则，规章（官方制定的管理条款）
调节，控制（保持系统稳定的过程）

Examples.English: The new regulation prohibits smoking in public areas.
Examples.Chinese: 新规禁止在公共场所吸烟。

Examples.English: Automatic temperature regulation ensures energy efficiency.
Examples.Chinese: 自动温度调节能确保能源效率。

Examples.English: Financial regulations aim to prevent market manipulation.
Examples.Chinese: 金融法规旨在防止市场操纵。

Words.Meaning: n. 排练，彩排（戏剧、音乐等表演前的练习）；n. 复述，重复（事件或陈述的详细叙述）

Senses.Definition: 排练，彩排（戏剧、音乐等表演前的练习）
复述，重复（事件或陈述的详细叙述）

Examples.English: The cast had a final rehearsal before the opening night.
Examples.Chinese: 剧组在首演前进行了最后一次彩排。

Examples.English: Her rehearsal of the accident details helped the police.
Examples.Chinese: 她对事故细节的复述帮助了警方调查。

Examples.English: Life is not a rehearsal—every moment counts.
Examples.Chinese: 人生不是彩排，每一刻都至关重要。

Words.Meaning: n. 统治时期；君主统治；vi. 统治；盛行

Examples.English: The king's reign lasted for over 50 years.
Examples.Chinese: 这位国王的统治持续了50多年。

Examples.English: Chaos reigned in the city after the earthquake.
Examples.Chinese: 地震后，城市陷入混乱。

Examples.English: Her reign as CEO transformed the company.
Examples.Chinese: 她担任CEO期间彻底改变了公司。

Words.Meaning: n. 缰绳；控制手段；vt. 用缰绳控制；约束

Examples.English: She pulled gently on the reins to slow the horse.
Examples.Chinese: 她轻轻拉动缰绳让马减速。

Examples.English: The government tightened the reins on public spending.
Examples.Chinese: 政府加强了对公共开支的控制。

Examples.English: He gave free rein to his imagination while writing the novel.
Examples.Chinese: 他在写小说时放任自己的想象力自由驰骋。

Words.Meaning: vi. 感到高兴；充满喜悦；vt. 使高兴（古用法）

Examples.English: The whole city rejoiced when the war ended.
Examples.Chinese: 战争结束时，整座城市欢欣鼓舞。

Examples.English: She rejoiced at her son's success.
Examples.Chinese: 她为儿子的成功感到欣喜。

Examples.English: "Rejoice!" shouted the priest to the crowd.
Examples.Chinese: “欢呼吧！”牧师向人群喊道。

Words.Meaning: n. 亲属；亲戚；adj. 相对的；比较的；相关的

Examples.English: She is a close relative of mine.
Examples.Chinese: 她是我的近亲。

Examples.English: The speed is relative to the observer's position.
Examples.Chinese: 速度与观察者的位置相对。

Examples.English: Happiness is a relative concept.
Examples.Chinese: 幸福是一个相对的概念。

Words.Meaning: n. 接力赛；中继设备；轮换班次；vt. 传递（信息）；转播（信号）

Senses.Definition: 接力赛；中继设备；轮换班次

Examples.English: The team won the 4x100m relay with a record time.
Examples.Chinese: 队伍以创纪录的成绩赢得了4x100米接力赛。

Examples.English: Satellite systems relay TV signals to remote areas.
Examples.Chinese: 卫星系统向偏远地区转播电视信号。

Examples.English: She relayed the urgent message to the manager.
Examples.Chinese: 她将紧急信息传达给了经理。

Words.Meaning: vt. 释放；解除；公开发布；n. 释放；发行；解脱

Examples.English: The government decided to release the political prisoners.
Examples.Chinese: 政府决定释放政治犯。

Examples.English: The band's new album will be released next month.
Examples.Chinese: 乐队的新专辑将于下月发行。

Examples.English: She sighed with release after finishing the final exam.
Examples.Chinese: 期末考试结束后，她如释重负地叹了口气。

Words.Meaning: n. 依赖；信任；n. 依靠的事物

Examples.English: His reliance on technology made him helpless during the blackout.
Examples.Chinese: 他对科技的依赖使他在停电时束手无策。

Examples.English: The project's success was a heavy reliance on teamwork.
Examples.Chinese: 该项目的成功极大依赖于团队合作。

Examples.English: Blind reliance on authority can hinder critical thinking.
Examples.Chinese: 对权威的盲目信赖会阻碍批判性思维。

Words.Meaning: n. （痛苦、压力等的）缓解；救济；浮雕；n. （法律）替代责任（如替班人员）

Senses.Definition: （痛苦、压力等的）缓解；救济；浮雕

Examples.English: The medicine brought immediate relief from pain.
Examples.Chinese: 药物迅速缓解了疼痛。

Examples.English: The government provided relief to flood victims.
Examples.Chinese: 政府向洪水灾民提供了救济。

Examples.English: The sculptor carved the figures in high relief.
Examples.Chinese: 雕刻家用高浮雕技法塑造了人像。

Words.Meaning: vt. 减轻（痛苦、压力等）；缓解；vt. 接替（某人职责）；解除（职务）

Senses.Definition: 接替（某人职责）；解除（职务）

Examples.English: The medicine helped relieve her headache.
Examples.Chinese: 药物缓解了她的头痛。

Examples.English: The guard will be relieved at midnight.
Examples.Chinese: 卫兵将在午夜换岗。

Examples.English: His apology relieved my anger.
Examples.Chinese: 他的道歉平息了我的怒火。

Words.Meaning: n. 宗教（一种对超自然力量或神灵的信仰与崇拜体系）；n. 宗教信仰（个人或群体的精神实践与价值观）

Senses.Definition: 宗教（一种对超自然力量或神灵的信仰与崇拜体系）
宗教信仰（个人或群体的精神实践与价值观）

Examples.English: She studies comparative religion to understand different cultural beliefs.
Examples.Chinese: 她研究比较宗教学以理解不同的文化信仰。

Examples.English: Freedom of religion is a fundamental human right.
Examples.Chinese: 宗教信仰自由是一项基本人权。

Examples.English: Ancient Egyptians practiced a polytheistic religion.
Examples.Chinese: 古埃及人信奉多神教。

Words.Meaning: adj. 宗教的；虔诚的；adj. 严谨的，一丝不苟的（引申义）

Senses.Definition: 严谨的，一丝不苟的（引申义）

Examples.English: She has a deeply religious faith.
Examples.Chinese: 她有着虔诚的宗教信仰。

Examples.English: He follows the schedule with religious precision.
Examples.Chinese: 他以一丝不苟的精确性遵循日程。

Examples.English: The festival is important to many religious communities.
Examples.Chinese: 这个节日对许多宗教群体至关重要。

Words.Meaning: n. 调味品；风味；享受；vt. 享受；喜好

Examples.English: She added a spoonful of relish to the hot dog.
Examples.Chinese: 她在热狗上加了一勺调味酱。

Examples.English: He relished the challenge of climbing the mountain.
Examples.Chinese: 他享受攀登这座山的挑战。

Examples.English: The story was told with great relish.
Examples.Chinese: 这个故事被津津有味地讲述着。

Words.Meaning: vi. 依赖；信任

Examples.English: You can rely on her to keep your secrets.
Examples.Chinese: 你可以信赖她保守你的秘密。

Examples.English: The project relies heavily on government funding.
Examples.Chinese: 该项目极大依赖政府资金。

Examples.English: Don't rely solely on luck to succeed.
Examples.Chinese: 别仅靠运气成功。

Words.Meaning: vi. 剩余；停留；保持（某种状态）；n. (常用复数 remains) 残余；遗迹

Senses.Definition: 剩余；停留；保持（某种状态）
(常用复数 remains) 残余；遗迹

Examples.English: Only a few apples remain on the tree.
Examples.Chinese: 树上只剩几个苹果了。

Examples.English: She chose to remain silent during the meeting.
Examples.Chinese: 会议期间她选择保持沉默。

Examples.English: The remains of the ancient temple attract many tourists.
Examples.Chinese: 古庙的遗迹吸引了许多游客。

Words.Meaning: n. 剩余部分；余数（数学）；vt. 廉价出售剩余库存

Examples.English: The remainder of the cake was saved for later.
Examples.Chinese: 蛋糕的剩余部分被留到稍后食用。

Examples.English: After dividing 10 by 3, the remainder is 1.
Examples.Chinese: 10除以3的余数是1。

Examples.English: The bookstore remaindered unsold copies of the novel.
Examples.Chinese: 书店将未售出的小说降价处理。

Words.Meaning: n. 治疗方法；补救措施；vt. 纠正；补救

Examples.English: Honey is a natural remedy for sore throats.
Examples.Chinese: 蜂蜜是治疗喉咙痛的自然疗法。

Examples.English: The new policy aims to remedy social inequality.
Examples.Chinese: 新政策旨在纠正社会不平等。

Examples.English: Time alone will not remedy the situation.
Examples.Chinese: 仅靠时间无法扭转局面。

Words.Meaning: n. 剩余物；残余部分；n. （布料、木材等的）零料，边角料

Examples.English: The archaeologists found a remnant of an ancient wall.
Examples.Chinese: 考古学家发现了一段古墙的残骸。

Examples.English: She used a remnant of silk to make a hair ribbon.
Examples.Chinese: 她用一块丝绸零料做了条发带。

Examples.English: Only a remnant of the original forest remains today.
Examples.Chinese: 如今仅存原始森林的一小部分。

Words.Meaning: adj. 遥远的；偏僻的；adj. 微小的（可能性）；n. 远程设备（如遥控器）

Examples.English: The village is so remote that it has no internet access.
Examples.Chinese: 这个村庄非常偏远，甚至没有网络。

Examples.English: There's a remote chance of rain tomorrow.
Examples.Chinese: 明天下雨的可能性很小。

Examples.English: She pressed a button on the remote to turn off the TV.
Examples.Chinese: 她按下遥控器的按钮关闭了电视。

Words.Meaning: n. 复兴；文艺复兴（欧洲14-17世纪的文化艺术运动）；n. （某一领域或风格的）复兴

Senses.Definition: 复兴；文艺复兴（欧洲14-17世纪的文化艺术运动）

Examples.English: The city experienced a cultural renaissance in the 1990s.
Examples.Chinese: 这座城市在20世纪90年代经历了文化复兴。

Examples.English: Renaissance art is characterized by its focus on humanism.
Examples.Chinese: 文艺复兴艺术以人文主义为核心特征。

Examples.English: Her latest album marks a renaissance in jazz music.
Examples.Chinese: 她的最新专辑标志着爵士乐的复兴。

Words.Meaning: vt. 偿还（金钱或债务）；vt. 回报（恩惠、帮助等）

Examples.English: She promised to repay the loan within a year.
Examples.Chinese: 她承诺一年内还清贷款。

Examples.English: How can I repay you for your kindness?
Examples.Chinese: 我该如何报答你的好意？

Words.Meaning: vt. 击退；排斥；使厌恶；vi. 产生排斥力；引起反感

Examples.English: The waterproof coating repels rainwater effectively.
Examples.Chinese: 防水涂层能有效阻隔雨水。

Examples.English: His arrogant attitude repelled potential collaborators.
Examples.Chinese: 他的傲慢态度让潜在合作者望而却步。

Examples.English: Like magnetic poles repel each other.
Examples.Chinese: 同磁极相互排斥。

Words.Meaning: n. （演员、艺术家等的）全部作品；常备剧目；n. （某人的）全部技能；全套本领

Senses.Definition: （演员、艺术家等的）全部作品；常备剧目

Examples.English: The actor's repertoire includes both classical and modern plays.
Examples.Chinese: 这位演员的常备剧目涵盖古典与现代戏剧。

Examples.English: She has a wide repertoire of teaching methods.
Examples.Chinese: 她掌握多种教学方法。

Examples.English: Jazz musicians often expand their repertoire by improvising.
Examples.Chinese: 爵士乐手常通过即兴演奏扩充曲目库。

Words.Meaning: vt. 代表；象征；vt. 描绘；表现；vt. 提出（意见、问题等）

Examples.English: The dove represents peace in many cultures.
Examples.Chinese: 鸽子在许多文化中象征和平。

Examples.English: She was chosen to represent the company at the conference.
Examples.Chinese: 她被选为代表公司出席会议。

Examples.English: The graph represents the data clearly.
Examples.Chinese: 图表清晰地呈现了数据。

Words.Meaning: n. 压制，镇压（尤指通过武力或权威）；n. （心理学）压抑（将痛苦记忆或冲动抑制到潜意识中）

Senses.Definition: 压制，镇压（尤指通过武力或权威）
（心理学）压抑（将痛苦记忆或冲动抑制到潜意识中）

Examples.English: The government used violent repression against the protest.
Examples.Chinese: 政府对抗议活动进行了暴力镇压。

Examples.English: Childhood trauma often leads to emotional repression.
Examples.Chinese: 童年创伤常导致情感压抑。

Examples.English: His repression of anger eventually caused health problems.
Examples.Chinese: 他对愤怒的压抑最终引发了健康问题。

Words.Meaning: n. 责备；耻辱；vt. 指责；使蒙羞

Examples.English: She reproached him for forgetting their anniversary.
Examples.Chinese: 她责备他忘记了他们的纪念日。

Examples.English: His failure was a reproach to the family.
Examples.Chinese: 他的失败是家族的耻辱。

Examples.English: The teacher’s gentle reproach made the student reflect.
Examples.Chinese: 老师温和的批评让学生开始反思。

Words.Meaning: n. 名誉，声望；n. （某方面的）评价，名声

Examples.English: His reputation as a fair judge is well deserved.
Examples.Chinese: 他作为公正法官的名声实至名归。

Examples.English: The company’s reputation suffered after the scandal.
Examples.Chinese: 丑闻发生后，公司的声誉受损。

Examples.English: She has a reputation for being strict but kind.
Examples.Chinese: 她以严格但善良著称。

Words.Meaning: n. 相似性；外表或特征的相似

Senses.Definition: 相似性；外表或特征的相似

Examples.English: The resemblance between the twins is striking.
Examples.Chinese: 这对双胞胎的相似度惊人。

Examples.English: There’s a faint resemblance of this painting to Picasso’s style.
Examples.Chinese: 这幅画与毕加索的风格有微弱的相似。

Examples.English: His mannerisms bear no resemblance to his father’s.
Examples.Chinese: 他的举止与他父亲毫无相似之处。

Words.Meaning: vt. 对…感到愤恨；因…而怨恨

Examples.English: She resented his arrogant attitude.
Examples.Chinese: 她对他的傲慢态度感到愤懑。

Examples.English: He resents being treated like a child.
Examples.Chinese: 他厌恶被当作小孩对待。

Examples.English: They secretly resented the new rules.
Examples.Chinese: 他们暗中对新规心怀不满。

Words.Meaning: n. 保留意见；保留条件；n. 预订（座位、房间等）；n. （美洲原住民的）保留地

Examples.English: She accepted the job offer with some reservations about the workload.
Examples.Chinese: 她接受了工作邀请，但对工作量有所保留。

Examples.English: I made a dinner reservation for two at 7 PM.
Examples.Chinese: 我预订了晚上7点的双人晚餐。

Examples.English: The Navajo Nation is the largest Native American reservation in the U.S.
Examples.Chinese: 纳瓦霍族保留地是美国最大的原住民保留地。

Words.Meaning: vt. 保留；预留；预订；n. 储备；自然保护区；克制

Examples.English: The hotel requires guests to reserve rooms in advance.
Examples.Chinese: 酒店要求客人提前预订房间。

Examples.English: She spoke with reserve, carefully choosing her words.
Examples.Chinese: 她说话克制，措辞谨慎。

Examples.English: The country's oil reserves are running low.
Examples.Chinese: 该国的石油储备正在减少。

Words.Meaning: vi. 居住；定居；vi. （性质等）存在，在于

Examples.English: She resides in a small village near the coast.
Examples.Chinese: 她居住在海边的一个小村庄里。

Examples.English: The power to make decisions resides with the board.
Examples.Chinese: 决策权掌握在董事会手中。

Examples.English: The charm of the city resides in its ancient architecture.
Examples.Chinese: 这座城市的魅力在于其古老的建筑。

Words.Meaning: n. 居民；住院医生；adj. 居住的；常驻的

Examples.English: The city has over a million residents.
Examples.Chinese: 这座城市有一百多万居民。

Examples.English: She is the resident expert on climate change.
Examples.Chinese: 她是常驻的气候变化专家。

Examples.English: The hospital’s residents work long shifts.
Examples.Chinese: 这家医院的住院医生轮班时间很长。

Words.Meaning: adj. 居住的；住宅的；adj. （工作、课程等）需住宿的

Examples.English: This area is primarily residential, with few commercial buildings.
Examples.Chinese: 该区域主要是住宅区，商业建筑很少。

Examples.English: The job requires residential training for the first month.
Examples.Chinese: 这份工作需要第一个月进行驻场培训。

Examples.English: The university offers both residential and online courses.
Examples.Chinese: 该大学提供住宿制和在线两种课程。

Words.Meaning: vt. 辞职；放弃（职位、权力等）；vt. 使顺从；听任（常与 to 连用）

Senses.Definition: 使顺从；听任（常与 to 连用）

Examples.English: She decided to resign from her position after ten years of service.
Examples.Chinese: 她决定在任职十年后辞去职务。

Examples.English: He resigned himself to the fact that he couldn’t change the outcome.
Examples.Chinese: 他无奈接受了无法改变结果的事实。

Examples.English: The CEO resigned amid the company’s financial scandal.
Examples.Chinese: 首席执行官在公司财务丑闻中辞职。

Words.Meaning: adj. 抵抗的；有抵抗力的；n. 抵抗者；防染剂（化学术语）

Senses.Definition: 抵抗者；防染剂（化学术语）

Examples.English: This fabric is resistant to water and stains.
Examples.Chinese: 这种面料防水防污。

Examples.English: Some bacteria have become resistant to antibiotics.
Examples.Chinese: 某些细菌对抗生素产生了耐药性。

Examples.English: She remained resistant to his persuasive arguments.
Examples.Chinese: 她始终抵制他的说服性论点。

Words.Meaning: n. 度假胜地；常去的地方；n. 求助；凭借的手段；vi. 求助；诉诸

Examples.English: The island is a popular resort for honeymooners.
Examples.Chinese: 这座岛是蜜月旅行者的热门度假胜地。

Examples.English: He resorted to stealing when he ran out of money.
Examples.Chinese: 他没钱时选择了偷窃。

Examples.English: Violence should never be the first resort in a conflict.
Examples.Chinese: 暴力绝不应该是冲突中的首选手段。

Words.Meaning: adj. 各自的；分别的

Examples.English: The team members returned to their respective offices after the meeting.
Examples.Chinese: 会议结束后，团队成员回到了各自的办公室。

Examples.English: The scholarships were awarded based on the students' respective achievements.
Examples.Chinese: 奖学金根据学生各自的成就颁发。

Examples.English: The two groups discussed their respective plans for the project.
Examples.Chinese: 两组分别讨论了各自的项目计划。

Words.Meaning: vi. 回应，答复；vt. 以…方式回应

Examples.English: She didn't respond to my email.
Examples.Chinese: 她没有回复我的邮件。

Examples.English: The patient is responding well to the treatment.
Examples.Chinese: 患者对治疗反应良好。

Examples.English: Firefighters responded immediately to the emergency call.
Examples.Chinese: 消防员立即响应了紧急呼叫。

Words.Meaning: n. 回应，答复；n. （生理或机械的）反应

Examples.English: She nodded in response to his question.
Examples.Chinese: 她点头回应了他的问题。

Examples.English: The vaccine triggers an immune response.
Examples.Chinese: 疫苗会引发免疫反应。

Examples.English: The machine’s response time is under 0.1 seconds.
Examples.Chinese: 该机器的响应时间低于0.1秒。

Words.Meaning: adj. 需承担责任的；有责任感的；adj. （职位或角色）重要的，责任重大的

Senses.Definition: 需承担责任的；有责任感的
（职位或角色）重要的，责任重大的

Examples.English: She is responsible for managing the team.
Examples.Chinese: 她负责管理团队。

Examples.English: A responsible citizen follows traffic rules.
Examples.Chinese: 有责任感的公民会遵守交通规则。

Examples.English: This is a highly responsible position in the company.
Examples.Chinese: 这是公司里一个责任重大的职位。

Words.Meaning: n. 克制，抑制；约束措施；n. （机械）限动装置

Examples.English: She exercised great restraint in not responding to the insult.
Examples.Chinese: 她表现出极大克制，没有回应侮辱。

Examples.English: The new safety restraints in cars have reduced injuries.
Examples.Chinese: 汽车的新型安全约束装置降低了伤害率。

Examples.English: His artistic restraint gives the painting a minimalist elegance.
Examples.Chinese: 他的艺术克制赋予画作极简的优雅。

Words.Meaning: vt. 限制；约束；vt. 限定（范围或权限）

Examples.English: The law restricts smoking in public places.
Examples.Chinese: 法律限制在公共场所吸烟。

Examples.English: Her visa restricts her to working only 20 hours per week.
Examples.Chinese: 她的签证限定她每周只能工作20小时。

Examples.English: The tight deadline restricted our creativity.
Examples.Chinese: 紧迫的截止日期限制了我们的创造力。

Words.Meaning: adj. 作为结果的；合成的；n. 合力；合成量（物理学/数学术语）

Senses.Definition: 合力；合成量（物理学/数学术语）

Examples.English: The resultant force of the two vectors was calculated precisely.
Examples.Chinese: 这两个向量的合力被精确计算出来。

Examples.English: The noise was the resultant effect of poor insulation.
Examples.Chinese: 噪音是隔音不良的直接结果。

Examples.English: In chemistry, a resultant compound often has new properties.
Examples.Chinese: 在化学中，合成化合物通常具有新特性。

Words.Meaning: vt. 重新开始；继续；n. 简历（美式用法，源自法语 résumé）

Senses.Definition: 简历（美式用法，源自法语 résumé）

Examples.English: She decided to resume her studies after a year off.
Examples.Chinese: 她决定休息一年后继续学业。

Examples.English: Please submit your resume by email.
Examples.Chinese: 请通过邮件提交你的简历。

Examples.English: The meeting will resume at 2 PM.
Examples.Chinese: 会议将于下午两点继续。

Words.Meaning: n. 保留；保持（如记忆、液体等）；n. （法律）留置权

Senses.Definition: 保留；保持（如记忆、液体等）

Examples.English: The sponge's water retention ability is impressive.
Examples.Chinese: 海绵的保水能力令人惊叹。

Examples.English: Employee retention strategies are crucial for company growth.
Examples.Chinese: 员工留任策略对公司发展至关重要。

Examples.English: His retention of details amazed the detectives.
Examples.Chinese: 他对细节的记忆力令侦探们震惊。

Words.Meaning: v. 反驳；回嘴；n. 反驳的话；蒸馏器（化学器具）

Senses.Definition: 反驳的话；蒸馏器（化学器具）

Examples.English: She retorted sharply, "That's not true!"
Examples.Chinese: 她尖锐地反驳：“那不是真的！”

Examples.English: The chemist heated the liquid in a glass retort.
Examples.Chinese: 化学家在玻璃蒸馏器中加热液体。

Examples.English: His retort left the audience laughing.
Examples.Chinese: 他的回嘴引得观众大笑。

Words.Meaning: vt. 取回，找回（某物）；vt. （计算机）检索数据；vt. （猎犬）衔回猎物

Examples.English: The dog was trained to retrieve the ball.
Examples.Chinese: 这只狗受过训练，能衔回球。

Examples.English: The system can retrieve data in seconds.
Examples.Chinese: 该系统可在几秒内检索数据。

Examples.English: She managed to retrieve her lost passport.
Examples.Chinese: 她成功找回了丢失的护照。

Words.Meaning: n. 回顾，回想；vt. 回顾，反思

Examples.English: In retrospect, I should have taken her advice.
Examples.Chinese: 回想起来，我本该听她的建议。

Examples.English: The book offers a retrospect of 20th-century art.
Examples.Chinese: 这本书对20世纪艺术进行了回顾。

Examples.English: He paused to retrospect his career achievements.
Examples.Chinese: 他停下来反思自己的职业成就。

Words.Meaning: n. 重聚；团聚；再联合

Examples.English: The family held a joyful reunion after ten years apart.
Examples.Chinese: 这个家庭在分离十年后举行了一次欢乐的团聚。

Examples.English: The university organizes an annual reunion for alumni.
Examples.Chinese: 这所大学每年为校友组织一次重聚活动。

Examples.English: The reunion of the band delighted fans worldwide.
Examples.Chinese: 乐队的重聚让全球乐迷欣喜不已。

Words.Meaning: n. 揭示；揭露（指真相或秘密的突然显现）；n. （宗教）天启，神示（特指上帝的启示）

Senses.Definition: 揭示；揭露（指真相或秘密的突然显现）
（宗教）天启，神示（特指上帝的启示）

Examples.English: The documentary was a revelation about climate change.
Examples.Chinese: 这部纪录片揭示了气候变化的真相。

Examples.English: Her sudden kindness came as a complete revelation to him.
Examples.Chinese: 她突如其来的善意对他而言如同天启。

Examples.English: The Book of Revelation contains apocalyptic visions.
Examples.Chinese: 《启示录》记载了末世异象。

Words.Meaning: n. 报复，复仇；vt. 替…报仇

Examples.English: He swore to take revenge on his enemies.
Examples.Chinese: 他发誓要向敌人复仇。

Examples.English: The movie explores the theme of revenge and redemption.
Examples.Chinese: 这部电影探讨了复仇与救赎的主题。

Examples.English: She revenged her brother's death by exposing the truth.
Examples.Chinese: 她通过揭露真相为弟弟的死报仇。

Words.Meaning: n. 财政收入；税收；n. （公司或组织的）总收入

Examples.English: The government's revenue increased by 10% this year.
Examples.Chinese: 今年政府财政收入增长了10%。

Examples.English: Advertising accounts for most of the company's revenue.
Examples.Chinese: 广告收入占该公司总收入的绝大部分。

Examples.English: Tourism is a major source of revenue for the island.
Examples.Chinese: 旅游业是该岛的主要收入来源。

Words.Meaning: adj. 相反的，反向的；n. 反面；倒退；失败；vt. 颠倒；撤销

Examples.English: She reversed the car into the parking space.
Examples.Chinese: 她将车倒进停车位。

Examples.English: The experiment produced the reverse effect of what we expected.
Examples.Chinese: 实验产生了与我们预期相反的效果。

Examples.English: The court reversed its earlier decision due to new evidence.
Examples.Chinese: 因新证据出现，法院撤销了先前的判决。

Words.Meaning: vt. 使复活；使复苏；恢复活力；vi. 复活；复兴；恢复生机

Senses.Definition: 使复活；使复苏；恢复活力

Examples.English: The rain revived the withered plants.
Examples.Chinese: 雨水使枯萎的植物恢复了生机。

Examples.English: This old song always revives my childhood memories.
Examples.Chinese: 这首老歌总能唤起我的童年回忆。

Examples.English: The government plans to revive the local economy.
Examples.Chinese: 政府计划振兴当地经济。

Words.Meaning: adj. 革命的；突破性的；n. 革命者

Examples.English: The invention of the internet was a revolutionary breakthrough.
Examples.Chinese: 互联网的发明是一项革命性突破。

Examples.English: She joined a group of revolutionaries fighting for independence.
Examples.Chinese: 她加入了一群为独立而战的革命者。

Examples.English: His revolutionary ideas challenged traditional education systems.
Examples.Chinese: 他的革新理念挑战了传统教育体系。

Words.Meaning: vi. 旋转；绕转；vt. 使旋转；反复思考

Examples.English: The Earth revolves around the Sun.
Examples.Chinese: 地球围绕太阳旋转。

Examples.English: She kept revolving the problem in her mind.
Examples.Chinese: 她一直在脑海中反复思考这个问题。

Examples.English: The exhibition revolves around themes of identity and migration.
Examples.Chinese: 展览以身份与移民为主题展开。

Words.Meaning: n. 报酬；回报；奖励；vt. 奖励；报答

Examples.English: She received a cash reward for her outstanding performance.
Examples.Chinese: 她因表现优异获得一笔现金奖励。

Examples.English: Kindness is its own reward.
Examples.Chinese: 善意本身就是回报。

Examples.English: The company rewards employees who propose innovative ideas.
Examples.Chinese: 公司奖励提出创新想法的员工。

Words.Meaning: n. 节奏；韵律；规律性运动

Examples.English: The drummer kept a steady rhythm throughout the song.
Examples.Chinese: 鼓手在整个歌曲中保持着稳定的节奏。

Examples.English: She has a natural sense of rhythm when dancing.
Examples.Chinese: 她跳舞时有一种天生的节奏感。

Examples.English: The rhythm of the seasons influences agricultural practices.
Examples.Chinese: 四季的规律循环影响着农业活动。

Words.Meaning: adj. 荒谬的，可笑的

Examples.English: The idea that pigs can fly is absolutely ridiculous.
Examples.Chinese: 认为猪会飞的想法简直荒谬至极。

Examples.English: She looked ridiculous in that oversized hat.
Examples.Chinese: 她戴着那顶过大的帽子，看起来滑稽可笑。

Examples.English: His excuse for being late was so ridiculous that no one believed it.
Examples.Chinese: 他迟到的借口太离谱，没人相信。

Words.Meaning: n. 钻井架；成套设备；操纵（尤指欺诈性）；vt. 装配；操纵（结果、选举等）

Senses.Definition: 钻井架；成套设备；操纵（尤指欺诈性）

Examples.English: The oil rig was visible on the horizon.
Examples.Chinese: 海上钻井平台在地平线上清晰可见。

Examples.English: They rigged the game to ensure their team would win.
Examples.Chinese: 他们操纵比赛以确保自己的队伍获胜。

Examples.English: The sailboat's rig needed repairs after the storm.
Examples.Chinese: 风暴过后，帆船的索具需要修理。

Words.Meaning: adj. 严格的，严厉的（指规则、标准等）；adj. 严密的，精确的（指方法、思维等）

Senses.Definition: 严格的，严厉的（指规则、标准等）
严密的，精确的（指方法、思维等）

Examples.English: The training program is rigorous but highly effective.
Examples.Chinese: 这个训练计划严格但非常高效。

Examples.English: She conducted a rigorous analysis of the data.
Examples.Chinese: 她对数据进行了严密的分析。

Examples.English: The professor has a rigorous approach to academic writing.
Examples.Chinese: 这位教授对学术写作持严谨态度。

Words.Meaning: n. 边缘，边框（如容器、圆形物体的外缘）；vt. 形成边缘；镶边

Senses.Definition: 边缘，边框（如容器、圆形物体的外缘）

Examples.English: The glass was filled to the rim with water.
Examples.Chinese: 玻璃杯中的水满到了边缘。

Examples.English: Mountains rimmed the horizon in the distance.
Examples.Chinese: 远方的群山在地平线上形成了一道轮廓。

Examples.English: She carefully painted a gold rim around the plate.
Examples.Chinese: 她在盘子边缘仔细描了一圈金边。

Words.Meaning: vt. 撕裂；劈开；vi. 裂开；被撕破；n. 裂口；撕开

Examples.English: She accidentally ripped her dress on a nail.
Examples.Chinese: 她的裙子不小心被钉子钩破了。

Examples.English: The wind ripped through the trees during the storm.
Examples.Chinese: 暴风雨中，风猛烈地穿过树林。

Examples.English: There’s a big rip in the old map.
Examples.Chinese: 这张旧地图上有一道很大的裂口。

Words.Meaning: n. 仪式；惯例；adj. 仪式的；惯例的

Examples.English: The tea ceremony is a traditional Japanese ritual.
Examples.Chinese: 茶道是日本的一种传统仪式。

Examples.English: Morning coffee became a comforting daily ritual for her.
Examples.Chinese: 早晨喝咖啡成了她令人安心的日常习惯。

Examples.English: The ritual of lighting candles symbolizes hope.
Examples.Chinese: 点燃蜡烛的仪式象征着希望。

Words.Meaning: n. 竞争对手；敌手；vt. 与…竞争；比得上

Examples.English: The two companies are fierce rivals in the tech industry.
Examples.Chinese: 这两家公司在科技行业是激烈的竞争对手。

Examples.English: Her talent rivals that of a professional musician.
Examples.Chinese: 她的才华堪比专业音乐家。

Examples.English: The siblings have always been rivals for their parents' attention.
Examples.Chinese: 这对兄妹一直为争夺父母的关注而竞争。

Words.Meaning: n. 竞争；对抗；n. 竞赛；较量

Examples.English: The rivalry between the two teams has lasted for decades.
Examples.Chinese: 两支队伍间的竞争已持续数十年。

Examples.English: Sibling rivalry is common in many families.
Examples.Chinese: 兄弟姐妹间的较劲在许多家庭中很常见。

Examples.English: Their professional rivalry pushed both to innovate.
Examples.Chinese: 他们的职业竞争促使双方不断创新。

Words.Meaning: n. 浪漫；爱情故事；传奇色彩；v. 虚构；渲染浪漫

Senses.Definition: 浪漫；爱情故事；传奇色彩

Examples.English: Their love story was like a fairy-tale romance.
Examples.Chinese: 他们的爱情故事如同童话般浪漫。

Examples.English: She enjoys reading historical romances set in medieval Europe.
Examples.Chinese: 她喜欢阅读以中世纪欧洲为背景的爱情小说。

Examples.English: Don’t romance the facts—just tell the truth.
Examples.Chinese: 别渲染事实，实话实说。

Words.Meaning: v. 腐烂；腐朽；n. 腐烂；腐败；废话

Examples.English: The wood began to rot after years of rain.
Examples.Chinese: 木材在多年雨水侵蚀后开始腐烂。

Examples.English: Don't talk such rot!
Examples.Chinese: 别说这种废话！

Examples.English: Without proper care, teeth can rot.
Examples.Chinese: 缺乏适当护理，牙齿会蛀坏。

Words.Meaning: adj. 旋转的；轮转的；n. 旋转式机器；环形交叉路（英式英语中称 roundabout）

Senses.Definition: 旋转式机器；环形交叉路（英式英语中称 roundabout）

Examples.English: The rotary blade of the fan cuts through the air smoothly.
Examples.Chinese: 风扇的旋转叶片平稳地切割空气。

Examples.English: She works for a rotary printing press company.
Examples.Chinese: 她在一家轮转印刷机公司工作。

Examples.English: Take the third exit at the rotary.
Examples.Chinese: 在环形交叉路口走第三个出口。

Words.Meaning: n. 常规；例行公事；固定程序；adj. 常规的；例行的；平淡的

Senses.Definition: 常规；例行公事；固定程序

Examples.English: Morning exercise is part of her daily routine.
Examples.Chinese: 晨练是她日常惯例的一部分。

Examples.English: The audit revealed no issues with routine procedures.
Examples.Chinese: 审计显示常规流程没有问题。

Examples.English: He longed to escape the routine of office life.
Examples.Chinese: 他渴望逃离办公室生活的单调。

Words.Meaning: n. 王室成员（总称）；王权；n. （专利、版权等的）特许使用费

Examples.English: The crown jewels symbolize British royalty.
Examples.Chinese: 皇冠珠宝象征着英国王室。

Examples.English: Authors receive royalties from book sales.
Examples.Chinese: 作者从图书销售中获取版税。

Examples.English: Oil companies pay royalties for drilling rights.
Examples.Chinese: 石油公司为开采权支付特许使用费。

Words.Meaning: n. 废墟；毁灭；破产；vt. 毁坏；使破产

Examples.English: The earthquake left the city in ruins.
Examples.Chinese: 地震使城市沦为废墟。

Examples.English: Gambling ruined his financial stability.
Examples.Chinese: 赌博毁了他的经济稳定。

Examples.English: The castle is now a picturesque ruin.
Examples.Chinese: 这座城堡如今是一片风景如画的废墟。

Words.Meaning: n. 破裂；断裂；疝气；vt. /vi. （使）破裂；（使）断裂

Examples.English: The pipeline ruptured due to extreme pressure.
Examples.Chinese: 管道因压力过大而破裂。

Examples.English: A sudden rupture in diplomatic relations shocked the world.
Examples.Chinese: 外交关系的突然破裂震惊了世界。

Examples.English: He suffered an abdominal rupture after lifting heavy weights.
Examples.Chinese: 他在举重后出现了腹部疝气。

Words.Meaning: adj. 神圣的（与宗教或神相关，不可侵犯的）；adj. 庄严的（因神圣性而受敬畏的）

Senses.Definition: 神圣的（与宗教或神相关，不可侵犯的）
庄严的（因神圣性而受敬畏的）

Examples.English: The temple is a sacred place for worship.
Examples.Chinese: 这座寺庙是神圣的礼拜场所。

Examples.English: She made a sacred promise to protect the secret.
Examples.Chinese: 她庄严承诺会保守这个秘密。

Examples.English: In many cultures, cows are considered sacred animals.
Examples.Chinese: 在许多文化中，牛被视为神圣的动物。

Words.Meaning: n. 牺牲；祭品；vt. 牺牲；献祭

Examples.English: She made many sacrifices to send her children to college.
Examples.Chinese: 她为送孩子上大学做出了许多牺牲。

Examples.English: The ancient ritual involved the sacrifice of a goat.
Examples.Chinese: 这一古老仪式包含献祭一只山羊。

Examples.English: He sacrificed his career to care for his family.
Examples.Chinese: 他牺牲事业来照顾家庭。

Words.Meaning: n. 保护措施；防护装置；vt. 保护；捍卫

Examples.English: The new law serves as a safeguard against data breaches.
Examples.Chinese: 这项新法律是防止数据泄露的保护措施。

Examples.English: Vaccination safeguards children from preventable diseases.
Examples.Chinese: 疫苗接种保护儿童免受可预防疾病的侵害。

Examples.English: Always wear a helmet to safeguard your head while cycling.
Examples.Chinese: 骑车时务必戴头盔以保护头部。

Words.Meaning: n. 目的；利益；理由；n. （日本清酒）

Examples.English: She quit her job for the sake of her mental health.
Examples.Chinese: 她为了心理健康辞去了工作。

Examples.English: He enjoys drinking warm sake in winter.
Examples.Chinese: 他喜欢在冬天喝温热的清酒。

Examples.English: Do it for my sake, if not for your own.
Examples.Chinese: 就算不为你自己，也看在我的份上做这件事吧。

Words.Meaning: n. 敬礼；致敬；致意；vt. 向…敬礼；向…致意；vi. 行礼；致敬

Examples.English: The soldier raised his hand to salute the officer.
Examples.Chinese: 士兵举手向军官敬礼。

Examples.English: We salute the brave healthcare workers during the pandemic.
Examples.Chinese: 我们向疫情期间勇敢的医护人员致敬。

Examples.English: In some cultures, a bow is used to salute instead of a hand gesture.
Examples.Chinese: 在某些文化中，人们用鞠躬代替手势致意。

Words.Meaning: n. 救赎，拯救（宗教或世俗意义上的解脱或救助）；n. 解救方法，补救措施

Senses.Definition: 救赎，拯救（宗教或世俗意义上的解脱或救助）

Examples.English: Many people find salvation through faith.
Examples.Chinese: 许多人通过信仰获得救赎。

Examples.English: The new policy was the salvation of the failing economy.
Examples.Chinese: 这项新政策挽救了衰退的经济。

Examples.English: She viewed education as her salvation from poverty.
Examples.Chinese: 她将教育视为摆脱贫穷的出路。

Words.Meaning: n. 样本；样品；示例；vt. 取样；尝试；体验

Examples.English: The doctor took a blood sample for testing.
Examples.Chinese: 医生采集了血液样本进行检测。

Examples.English: This free cookie is a sample of our new product.
Examples.Chinese: 这块免费饼干是我们新产品的试吃样品。

Examples.English: She sampled several courses before choosing her major.
Examples.Chinese: 她体验了几门课程后才选定专业。

Words.Meaning: n. 制裁；批准；许可；vt. 批准；对…实施制裁

Examples.English: The UN imposed economic sanctions on the country.
Examples.Chinese: 联合国对该国实施经济制裁。

Examples.English: The law received royal sanction in 1689.
Examples.Chinese: 这项法律于1689年获得王室批准。

Examples.English: Many critics argue that sanctions often harm civilians more than governments.
Examples.Chinese: 许多批评者认为，制裁对平民的伤害往往大于对政府的打击。

Words.Meaning: vt. 使饱和；浸透；vt. （化学）使（溶液）达到饱和状态

Examples.English: The heavy rain saturated the soil, causing local flooding.
Examples.Chinese: 大雨浸透了土壤，导致局部积水。

Examples.English: This solution is saturated with salt at room temperature.
Examples.Chinese: 该溶液在室温下已达到盐的饱和状态。

Examples.English: The market is saturated with similar products, making competition fierce.
Examples.Chinese: 市场上同类产品已趋饱和，竞争十分激烈。

Words.Meaning: adj. 野蛮的；未开化的；凶猛的；n. 野蛮人；粗鲁的人；vt. 猛烈攻击；残酷对待

Senses.Definition: 野蛮的；未开化的；凶猛的

Examples.English: The explorers encountered a savage tribe deep in the jungle.
Examples.Chinese: 探险者在丛林深处遇到了一个野蛮部落。

Examples.English: His savage criticism left her in tears.
Examples.Chinese: 他尖锐的批评让她泪流满面。

Examples.English: The lion made a savage attack on its prey.
Examples.Chinese: 狮子对猎物发起了凶猛的攻击。

Words.Meaning: n. 刻度；比例；规模；鳞片；vt. 攀登；测量；刮除鳞片；vi. 逐步增加；剥落

Examples.English: The map has a scale of 1:50,000.
Examples.Chinese: 这张地图的比例尺是1:5万。

Examples.English: Salmon lose their scales when they swim upstream.
Examples.Chinese: 鲑鱼溯流而上时会脱落鳞片。

Examples.English: She scaled the mountain in record time.
Examples.Chinese: 她以破纪录的速度登上了山顶。

Words.Meaning: vt. 扫描；细看；快速浏览；n. 扫描；检查；概要

Examples.English: The doctor will scan your brain for abnormalities.
Examples.Chinese: 医生将扫描你的大脑以检查异常。

Examples.English: She quickly scanned the newspaper for weather updates.
Examples.Chinese: 她快速浏览报纸寻找天气信息。

Examples.English: The radar scan detected an unknown object.
Examples.Chinese: 雷达扫描发现了一个未知物体。

Words.Meaning: n. 丑闻；公愤；流言蜚语

Examples.English: The politician resigned after the financial scandal was exposed.
Examples.Chinese: 这位政治家在财务丑闻曝光后辞职。

Examples.English: The tabloids love to spread scandals about celebrities.
Examples.Chinese: 小报热衷于传播名人的绯闻。

Examples.English: Her actions caused a scandal in the conservative community.
Examples.Chinese: 她的行为在保守社区引发了公愤。

Words.Meaning: n. 疤痕；伤痕；（精神上的）创伤；vt. 使留下伤痕；在…上结疤

Senses.Definition: 疤痕；伤痕；（精神上的）创伤

Examples.English: The surgery left a small scar on her knee.
Examples.Chinese: 手术在她的膝盖上留下了一道小疤痕。

Examples.English: Childhood trauma can scar a person for life.
Examples.Chinese: 童年创伤可能给人留下终身的心理阴影。

Examples.English: The volcanic eruption scarred the landscape permanently.
Examples.Chinese: 火山喷发永久性地改变了地貌的样貌。

Words.Meaning: vt. 使分散；撒播；vi. 分散；散开

Examples.English: The wind will scatter the leaves across the yard.
Examples.Chinese: 风会把树叶吹散到院子里。

Examples.English: Birds scattered as the dog ran toward them.
Examples.Chinese: 狗跑向鸟群时，鸟儿四散飞走。

Examples.English: She scattered rose petals along the aisle.
Examples.Chinese: 她将玫瑰花瓣撒在过道上。

Words.Meaning: n. 气味；香味；线索；vt. 嗅到；察觉

Examples.English: The scent of roses filled the garden.
Examples.Chinese: 玫瑰的香气弥漫花园。

Examples.English: The dog quickly picked up the scent of the fox.
Examples.Chinese: 狗迅速捕捉到狐狸的气味。

Examples.English: She scented trouble when he avoided her questions.
Examples.Chinese: 当他回避问题时，她察觉到了麻烦。

Words.Meaning: n. 时间表；计划表；清单；vt. 安排；将…列入计划

Examples.English: The project is behind schedule due to unexpected delays.
Examples.Chinese: 该项目因意外延误而落后于计划进度。

Examples.English: Please schedule a meeting for next Monday.
Examples.Chinese: 请为下周一安排一次会议。

Examples.English: Check the train schedule before you leave.
Examples.Chinese: 出发前查好火车时刻表。

Words.Meaning: n. 计划；方案；阴谋；vt. /vi. 密谋；策划

Examples.English: The government launched a new housing scheme.
Examples.Chinese: 政府推出了一项新的住房计划。

Examples.English: He was accused of scheming to overthrow the management.
Examples.Chinese: 他被指控密谋推翻管理层。

Examples.English: Her scheme to avoid taxes was eventually discovered.
Examples.Chinese: 她避税的阴谋最终被揭露。

Words.Meaning: n. 得分；分数；二十；刻痕；vt. 得分；刻划；记分；vi. 得分；记分

Examples.English: The final score was 3-2.
Examples.Chinese: 最终比分为3比2。

Examples.English: He scored a goal in the last minute.
Examples.Chinese: 他在最后一分钟进了一球。

Examples.English: She made a score on the tree to mark the trail.
Examples.Chinese: 她在树上刻了一道痕迹以标记路线。

Words.Meaning: n. 轻蔑，鄙视；vt. 轻蔑地拒绝；不屑做

Examples.English: She looked at him with cold scorn.
Examples.Chinese: 她以冰冷的轻蔑目光看着他。

Examples.English: He scorned all offers of help.
Examples.Chinese: 他不屑地拒绝了所有帮助提议。

Examples.English: Their scorn for the proposal was evident.
Examples.Chinese: 他们对这一提议的鄙夷显而易见。

Words.Meaning: vi. 攀爬；争夺；仓促行动；vt. 炒（蛋）；使混杂；扰乱；n. 混乱；争夺；攀爬

Examples.English: The hikers scrambled up the rocky slope.
Examples.Chinese: 登山者们手脚并用地爬上了岩石斜坡。

Examples.English: Journalists scrambled to get the latest news.
Examples.Chinese: 记者们争先恐后地获取最新消息。

Examples.English: She scrambled the eggs with some fresh herbs.
Examples.Chinese: 她用新鲜香草炒了鸡蛋。

Words.Meaning: n. 碎片；废料；残余物；vt. 废弃；报废；将…作为废料处理；n. （非正式）争吵；打架

Senses.Definition: 废弃；报废；将…作为废料处理

Examples.English: She collected scraps of paper to make a collage.
Examples.Chinese: 她收集纸片制作拼贴画。

Examples.English: The old car was finally scrapped after years of use.
Examples.Chinese: 这辆旧车在使用多年后最终被报废。

Examples.English: They got into a silly scrap over who should wash the dishes.
Examples.Chinese: 他们为谁该洗碗吵了一架。

Words.Meaning: vt. 刮擦；擦伤；艰难地获取；n. 刮擦声；擦伤；困境

Examples.English: She fell and scraped her knee on the pavement.
Examples.Chinese: 她摔倒时膝盖在人行道上擦伤了。

Examples.English: The branches scraped against the window in the wind.
Examples.Chinese: 树枝在风中刮擦着窗户。

Examples.English: He managed to scrape together enough money for the trip.
Examples.Chinese: 他勉强凑够了旅行的钱。

Words.Meaning: v. 抓；挠；刮擦；n. 抓痕；刮擦声；草稿

Examples.English: The cat will scratch you if you pull its tail.
Examples.Chinese: 如果你拉猫的尾巴，它会抓你。

Examples.English: He heard a scratch on the window and turned around.
Examples.Chinese: 他听到窗户上有刮擦声，于是转过身。

Examples.English: I’ll just jot down a few scratch notes before the meeting.
Examples.Chinese: 我会在会议前草草记下几条笔记。

Words.Meaning: n. 螺丝；螺旋状物；vt. 用螺丝固定；拧紧；扭曲（比喻义）

Senses.Definition: 用螺丝固定；拧紧；扭曲（比喻义）

Examples.English: Tighten the screw with a screwdriver.
Examples.Chinese: 用螺丝刀拧紧螺丝。

Examples.English: He screwed the lid onto the jar.
Examples.Chinese: 他把盖子拧到罐子上。

Examples.English: The scandal screwed up his reputation.
Examples.Chinese: 丑闻彻底毁了他的名声。

Words.Meaning: v. 用力擦洗；取消（计划）；n. 灌木丛；矮小植物；擦洗动作

Senses.Definition: 灌木丛；矮小植物；擦洗动作

Examples.English: She scrubbed the floor until it shone.
Examples.Chinese: 她用力擦洗地板，直到它发亮。

Examples.English: The pilot scrubbed the flight due to bad weather.
Examples.Chinese: 因天气恶劣，飞行员取消了航班。

Examples.English: We hiked through dense scrub to reach the coast.
Examples.Chinese: 我们穿过茂密的灌木丛抵达海岸。

Words.Meaning: n. 雕塑；雕刻品；vt. 雕刻；塑造

Examples.English: The museum exhibits ancient Greek sculptures.
Examples.Chinese: 博物馆展出了古希腊雕塑。

Examples.English: She sculptured a lion out of marble.
Examples.Chinese: 她用大理石雕刻了一头狮子。

Examples.English: His poetry sculptures vivid images in the reader's mind.
Examples.Chinese: 他的诗歌在读者脑海中塑造出生动的意象。

Words.Meaning: n. 接缝；缝合处；缝隙；vt. 缝合；使留下伤痕

Examples.English: The tailor stitched the seam with invisible thread.
Examples.Chinese: 裁缝用隐形线缝合了接缝。

Examples.English: A seam of coal was discovered beneath the mountains.
Examples.Chinese: 山脉下发现了一条煤层。

Examples.English: Her speech revealed the cultural seams in the community.
Examples.Chinese: 她的演讲暴露了社区中的文化裂痕。

Words.Meaning: n. 安全；保障；n. 证券（金融术语）

Examples.English: The new software enhances data security.
Examples.Chinese: 新软件提升了数据安全性。

Examples.English: She works in airport security.
Examples.Chinese: 她在机场安保部门工作。

Examples.English: Government bonds are considered low-risk securities.
Examples.Chinese: 国债被视为低风险证券。

Words.Meaning: adv. 表面上；看起来

Examples.English: He was seemingly unaware of the chaos around him.
Examples.Chinese: 他看似没有注意到周围的混乱。

Examples.English: The plan is seemingly simple, but full of hidden complexities.
Examples.Chinese: 这个计划表面上简单，实则暗藏复杂。

Examples.English: She smiled seemingly without effort, though her eyes were tired.
Examples.Chinese: 她看似轻松地微笑着，尽管眼神疲惫。

Words.Meaning: n. 部分；片段；段；vt. 分割；划分

Examples.English: The orange was divided into several segments.
Examples.Chinese: 橘子被分成了几瓣。

Examples.English: The report analyzed each market segment in detail.
Examples.Chinese: 报告详细分析了每个细分市场。

Examples.English: Researchers segmented the data by age groups.
Examples.Chinese: 研究人员按年龄组对数据进行了划分。

Words.Meaning: vt. 隔离；分离（人或群体）；vi. 分开；实行隔离

Examples.English: The school was criticized for segregating students by ability.
Examples.Chinese: 这所学校因按能力分班而受到批评。

Examples.English: Birds often segregate into flocks during migration.
Examples.Chinese: 鸟类迁徙时常分群飞行。

Examples.English: The law once segregated public facilities by race.
Examples.Chinese: 该法律曾按种族隔离公共设施。

Words.Meaning: n. 学期（通常指大学或学校一年中分为两部分的半学年）

Senses.Definition: 学期（通常指大学或学校一年中分为两部分的半学年）

Examples.English: The fall semester starts in September.
Examples.Chinese: 秋季学期从九月开始。

Examples.English: She took five courses last semester.
Examples.Chinese: 她上学期修了五门课。

Examples.English: The final exams mark the end of the semester.
Examples.Chinese: 期末考试标志着学期结束。

Words.Meaning: n. 参议员（立法机构成员，尤指美国参议院或古罗马元老院成员）

Senses.Definition: 参议员（立法机构成员，尤指美国参议院或古罗马元老院成员）

Examples.English: The senator proposed a new environmental bill.
Examples.Chinese: 这位参议员提出了一项新的环境法案。

Examples.English: In ancient Rome, senators wore distinctive purple stripes.
Examples.Chinese: 古罗马元老院成员身着特殊的紫色条纹长袍。

Examples.English: She became the youngest state senator in history.
Examples.Chinese: 她成为历史上最年轻的州参议员。

Words.Meaning: n. 感觉，知觉（如触觉、听觉等）；n. 轰动，引起轰动的事物

Senses.Definition: 感觉，知觉（如触觉、听觉等）

Examples.English: The cold water caused a sharp sensation on her skin.
Examples.Chinese: 冷水在她的皮肤上引起刺痛感。

Examples.English: The new art exhibit became a sensation in the city.
Examples.Chinese: 这场新艺术展览在城里引起了轰动。

Examples.English: He lost all sensation in his legs after the accident.
Examples.Chinese: 事故后，他的双腿完全失去了知觉。

Words.Meaning: adj. 明智的；合理的；adj. 可感知的（古义，现少用）

Examples.English: It's sensible to save money for emergencies.
Examples.Chinese: 为紧急情况存钱是明智之举。

Examples.English: She gave me some sensible advice.
Examples.Chinese: 她给了我一些合理的建议。

Examples.English: The patient was sensible of a sharp pain.
Examples.Chinese: 病人感觉到一阵剧痛。（古义用法）

Words.Meaning: adj. 敏感的；易受影响的；adj. 体贴的；善解人意的；adj. （设备）灵敏的

Examples.English: She is very sensitive to criticism.
Examples.Chinese: 她对批评非常敏感。

Examples.English: The device is highly sensitive to temperature changes.
Examples.Chinese: 该设备对温度变化高度灵敏。

Examples.English: He gave a sensitive performance as the grieving father.
Examples.Chinese: 他饰演悲恸的父亲，表演细腻动人。

Words.Meaning: n. 情感，情绪（尤指基于个人观点的感性态度）；n. 观点，意见（常带主观色彩）

Senses.Definition: 情感，情绪（尤指基于个人观点的感性态度）
观点，意见（常带主观色彩）

Examples.English: Her speech appealed to the patriotic sentiments of the crowd.
Examples.Chinese: 她的演讲唤起了人群的爱国情绪。

Examples.English: Market sentiment has turned pessimistic due to recent economic data.
Examples.Chinese: 由于近期经济数据，市场情绪转向悲观。

Examples.English: He expressed a sentiment shared by many in the room.
Examples.Chinese: 他表达了房间里许多人的共同观点。

Words.Meaning: n. 军士，中士（军队中低级军官）；n. 警官（某些国家警察职级）

Senses.Definition: 军士，中士（军队中低级军官）
警官（某些国家警察职级）

Examples.English: The sergeant drilled the new recruits every morning.
Examples.Chinese: 中士每天早晨训练新兵。

Examples.English: She was promoted to sergeant after five years of service.
Examples.Chinese: 服役五年后，她晋升为警司。

Examples.English: The sergeant major inspected the barracks with strict attention to detail.
Examples.Chinese: 军士长以极其严格的标准检查了营房。

Words.Meaning: adj. 连续的；序列的；n. 连载作品；系列节目

Examples.English: The novel was published in serial form over six months.
Examples.Chinese: 这部小说以连载形式分六个月发表。

Examples.English: She owns a rare serial number on the vintage watch.
Examples.Chinese: 她拥有一块古董表上的稀有序列号。

Examples.English: The police are investigating a serial offender.
Examples.Chinese: 警方正在调查一名连环罪犯。

Words.Meaning: n. 系列（按顺序排列的相似事物）；n. 连续；连载（如电视、书籍）

Senses.Definition: 系列（按顺序排列的相似事物）

Examples.English: The lecture series covers topics from ancient to modern art.
Examples.Chinese: 该系列讲座涵盖从古代到现代的艺术主题。

Examples.English: She owns the complete series of detective novels.
Examples.Chinese: 她拥有这套侦探小说的完整系列。

Examples.English: A series of errors led to the system failure.
Examples.Chinese: 一连串错误导致了系统故障。

Words.Meaning: n. 挫折；阻碍（指计划或进展中的困难或倒退）

Senses.Definition: 挫折；阻碍（指计划或进展中的困难或倒退）

Examples.English: The team faced a major setback when their funding was cut.
Examples.Chinese: 团队因资金削减遭遇重大挫折。

Examples.English: Despite the setback, she continued working toward her goal.
Examples.Chinese: 尽管遇到阻碍，她仍坚持向目标努力。

Examples.English: The project’s delay was only a temporary setback.
Examples.Chinese: 项目延误只是暂时的挫折。

Words.Meaning: vt. 解决；安顿；使定居；vi. 定居；沉淀；安定；n. 高背长椅（古义）

Examples.English: They decided to settle the dispute peacefully.
Examples.Chinese: 他们决定和平解决争端。

Examples.English: Dust particles will settle at the bottom of the container.
Examples.Chinese: 尘埃颗粒会沉淀在容器底部。

Examples.English: After years of traveling, she finally settled in a small village.
Examples.Chinese: 多年漂泊后，她最终在一个小村庄定居。

Words.Meaning: n. 定居点；殖民地；n. （法律）和解协议；n. （款项的）支付；结算

Examples.English: The Vikings established a settlement in Greenland.
Examples.Chinese: 维京人在格陵兰建立了定居点。

Examples.English: The two companies reached a settlement out of court.
Examples.Chinese: 两家公司达成了庭外和解。

Examples.English: The bank requires immediate settlement of the debt.
Examples.Chinese: 银行要求立即结清债务。

Words.Meaning: adj. 严厉的；苛刻的；adj. 严重的；剧烈的；adj. 朴素的；不加装饰的

Examples.English: The judge imposed a severe sentence on the criminal.
Examples.Chinese: 法官对罪犯判处了严厉的刑罚。

Examples.English: She suffered from severe headaches after the accident.
Examples.Chinese: 事故后她患上了严重的头痛。

Examples.English: The building's design is severe, with no unnecessary decorations.
Examples.Chinese: 这座建筑的设计非常朴素，没有任何多余的装饰。

Words.Meaning: adj. 破旧的，衣衫褴褛的；adj. 卑鄙的，不公正的

Examples.English: He lived in a shabby apartment with peeling wallpaper.
Examples.Chinese: 他住在一间墙纸剥落的破旧公寓里。

Examples.English: It was a shabby trick to blame the new employee for the mistake.
Examples.Chinese: 把错误归咎于新员工是卑鄙的手段。

Examples.English: Her shabby coat barely kept her warm in the winter wind.
Examples.Chinese: 她那件破旧的外套几乎无法在寒风中保暖。

Words.Meaning: n. 长杆；轴；竖井；箭杆；vt. 欺骗；苛刻对待

Examples.English: The arrow's shaft was made of lightweight cedar.
Examples.Chinese: 箭杆由轻质的雪松木制成。

Examples.English: The elevator got stuck in the shaft between floors.
Examples.Chinese: 电梯卡在楼层间的竖井里。

Examples.English: He felt shafted by the unfair contract terms.
Examples.Chinese: 他因不公平的合同条款感到被坑了。

Words.Meaning: n. 鲨鱼（海洋大型掠食性鱼类）；n. 贪婪的人；诈骗者（俚语）；vt. 诈骗；敲诈（俚语）

Senses.Definition: 鲨鱼（海洋大型掠食性鱼类）

Examples.English: The great white shark is an apex predator of the ocean.
Examples.Chinese: 大白鲨是海洋中的顶级掠食者。

Examples.English: He was accused of sharking vulnerable investors.
Examples.Chinese: 他被指控诈骗弱势投资者。

Examples.English: Don’t trust that guy—he’s a loan shark.
Examples.Chinese: 别相信那个人，他是个放高利贷的。

Words.Meaning: vt. 粉碎；彻底破坏（物理或抽象）；vi. 破碎；碎裂；n. 碎片；粉碎状态

Senses.Definition: 粉碎；彻底破坏（物理或抽象）

Examples.English: The vase shattered into a thousand pieces when it hit the floor.
Examples.Chinese: 花瓶摔在地上，粉碎成无数碎片。

Examples.English: His dreams were shattered by the financial crisis.
Examples.Chinese: 金融危机彻底粉碎了他的梦想。

Examples.English: The loud explosion shattered the calm of the night.
Examples.Chinese: 巨大的爆炸声打破了夜晚的宁静。

Words.Meaning: n. 棚屋；简易房；vt. 脱落（毛发、皮肤等）；流出（眼泪）；摆脱（负担）

Senses.Definition: 脱落（毛发、皮肤等）；流出（眼泪）；摆脱（负担）

Examples.English: The gardener stored tools in the wooden shed.
Examples.Chinese: 园丁把工具存放在木棚里。

Examples.English: Snakes shed their skin as they grow.
Examples.Chinese: 蛇在生长过程中会蜕皮。

Examples.English: She shed tears of joy at the news.
Examples.Chinese: 听到消息后，她流下了喜悦的泪水。

Words.Meaning: adj. 完全的，纯粹的（强调程度）；adj. 陡峭的，垂直的（形容坡度）；vi. 急转，偏离（尤指船只航行）

Senses.Definition: 完全的，纯粹的（强调程度）
陡峭的，垂直的（形容坡度）
急转，偏离（尤指船只航行）

Examples.English: The cliff dropped in a sheer descent of 100 meters.
Examples.Chinese: 悬崖垂直陡降100米。

Examples.English: Her success was due to sheer determination.
Examples.Chinese: 她的成功纯粹源于决心。

Examples.English: The ship sheered away to avoid the iceberg.
Examples.Chinese: 船只急转以避开冰山。

Words.Meaning: n. 牧羊人；牧师（比喻用法）；vt. 引导；照管（如牧羊般）

Examples.English: The shepherd led his flock through the valley.
Examples.Chinese: 牧羊人带领羊群穿过山谷。

Examples.English: Teachers often shepherd students toward critical thinking.
Examples.Chinese: 教师常引导学生培养批判性思维。

Examples.English: The pastor is seen as a spiritual shepherd in the community.
Examples.Chinese: 这位牧师被视为社区的精神指引者。

Words.Meaning: n. 盾；防护物；保护者；vt. 保护；遮挡

Examples.English: The knight raised his shield to block the arrow.
Examples.Chinese: 骑士举起盾牌挡住了箭。

Examples.English: Sunglasses shield your eyes from UV rays.
Examples.Chinese: 太阳镜能保护眼睛免受紫外线伤害。

Examples.English: She acted as a shield between the protesters and the police.
Examples.Chinese: 她在抗议者和警察之间充当了保护者的角色。

Words.Meaning: n. 货物运输；装运；n. 运输的货物

Examples.English: The shipment of goods was delayed due to bad weather.
Examples.Chinese: 货物运输因恶劣天气延误。

Examples.English: We received a large shipment of books yesterday.
Examples.Chinese: 我们昨天收到一大批书籍的货运。

Examples.English: Track your shipment online with the provided tracking number.
Examples.Chinese: 用提供的运单号在线追踪您的货物。

Words.Meaning: vt. 猛推；乱塞；vi. 推挤；n. 推搡

Examples.English: He shoved the papers into his bag angrily.
Examples.Chinese: 他怒气冲冲地把文件塞进包里。

Examples.English: The crowd shoved forward to see the performer.
Examples.Chinese: 人群推挤着向前去看表演者。

Examples.English: She gave him a shove to wake him up.
Examples.Chinese: 她推了他一把把他弄醒。

Words.Meaning: adj. 精明的，敏锐的（尤指判断或决策）；adj. 狡猾的（略带贬义）

Senses.Definition: 精明的，敏锐的（尤指判断或决策）

Examples.English: She made a shrewd investment and doubled her profits.
Examples.Chinese: 她做了一笔精明的投资，利润翻了一番。

Examples.English: His shrewd observation skills helped him solve the mystery.
Examples.Chinese: 他敏锐的观察力帮助他解开了谜团。

Examples.English: The politician’s shrewd tactics earned both admiration and criticism.
Examples.Chinese: 这位政客狡猾的策略既赢得了赞赏，也招致批评。

Words.Meaning: vi. 收缩；退缩；vt. 使收缩；使缩小；n. （俚语）心理医生（源自“headshrinker”的缩写）

Examples.English: She visits her shrink every Thursday.
Examples.Chinese: 她每周四去看心理医生。

Words.Meaning: n. 灌木（低矮木本植物）；n. 果汁甜酒（由果汁、糖和烈酒混合的饮料）

Senses.Definition: 果汁甜酒（由果汁、糖和烈酒混合的饮料）

Examples.English: The garden was bordered by flowering shrubs.
Examples.Chinese: 花园边缘种着开花的灌木。

Examples.English: She ordered a rum shrub at the colonial-themed bar.
Examples.Chinese: 她在殖民风格酒吧点了一杯朗姆果汁甜酒。

Examples.English: Ants built nests under the dense shrub.
Examples.Chinese: 蚂蚁在茂密的灌木下筑巢。

Words.Meaning: v. 耸肩（表示不确定、冷漠或无奈）；n. 耸肩的动作

Senses.Definition: 耸肩（表示不确定、冷漠或无奈）

Examples.English: She shrugged when asked about the missing files.
Examples.Chinese: 当被问及丢失的文件时，她耸了耸肩。

Examples.English: His shrug indicated he didn't care.
Examples.Chinese: 他的耸肩表明他不在乎。

Examples.English: The politician gave a vague shrug to avoid answering.
Examples.Chinese: 政客含糊地耸了耸肩以回避回答。

Words.Meaning: n. 百叶窗；快门；关闭装置；vt. 关闭（窗户或快门）

Examples.English: She closed the wooden shutters to block out the sunlight.
Examples.Chinese: 她关上木制百叶窗以遮挡阳光。

Examples.English: The camera’s shutter speed affects the exposure of the photo.
Examples.Chinese: 相机的快门速度影响照片的曝光。

Examples.English: They decided to shutter the business after years of losses.
Examples.Chinese: 在多年亏损后，他们决定关闭这家企业。

Words.Meaning: n. 梭子（织布工具）；短程往返交通工具（如航天飞机、班车）；vt. /vi. 往返运送；频繁移动

Senses.Definition: 梭子（织布工具）；短程往返交通工具（如航天飞机、班车）

Examples.English: The weaver's shuttle flies across the loom.
Examples.Chinese: 织布机的梭子在织机上飞速穿梭。

Examples.English: A shuttle bus runs between the airport and downtown every 30 minutes.
Examples.Chinese: 班车每30分钟在机场和市中心之间往返一次。

Examples.English: NASA retired its space shuttle program in 2011.
Examples.Chinese: 美国宇航局于2011年退役了航天飞机项目。

Words.Meaning: n. 围困，围攻（军事行动）；n. 长期困扰（比喻义）

Examples.English: The city endured a brutal siege for six months.
Examples.Chinese: 这座城市经历了长达六个月的残酷围困。

Examples.English: The team faced a siege of criticism after their defeat.
Examples.Chinese: 球队在失败后遭到连番批评。

Examples.English: Medieval castles were designed to withstand sieges.
Examples.Chinese: 中世纪城堡的设计旨在抵御围攻。

Words.Meaning: n. 筛子；滤网；vt. 筛选；过滤

Examples.English: Pass the sauce through a sieve to remove lumps.
Examples.Chinese: 将酱汁过筛以去除结块。

Examples.English: The investigation aims to sieve facts from rumors.
Examples.Chinese: 调查旨在从谣言中筛选事实。

Examples.English: Sand sieves are essential tools for archaeologists.
Examples.Chinese: 砂筛是考古学家的必备工具。

Words.Meaning: n. 信号；标志；迹象；vt. 用信号表示；标志；adj. 显著的；作为信号的

Examples.English: The lighthouse sends a bright signal to guide ships at night.
Examples.Chinese: 灯塔在夜间发出明亮的信号引导船只。

Examples.English: Her sudden silence was a signal that something was wrong.
Examples.Chinese: 她突然的沉默预示着出了问题。

Examples.English: The treaty is seen as a signal achievement in diplomatic history.
Examples.Chinese: 该条约被视为外交史上的显著成就。

Words.Meaning: vt. 表示，意味着；vt. 预示，象征

Examples.English: A red traffic light signifies that you must stop.
Examples.Chinese: 红色交通灯表示你必须停下。

Examples.English: Dark clouds often signify an approaching storm.
Examples.Chinese: 乌云常预示着暴风雨来临。

Examples.English: His silence signified disapproval of the plan.
Examples.Chinese: 他的沉默意味着不赞同该计划。

Words.Meaning: n. 硅（化学元素，符号 Si）；n. 硅材料（用于电子工业等）

Senses.Definition: 硅材料（用于电子工业等）

Examples.English: Silicon is widely used in computer chips and solar panels.
Examples.Chinese: 硅广泛应用于计算机芯片和太阳能电池板。

Examples.English: Pure silicon reacts with oxygen to form silicon dioxide.
Examples.Chinese: 纯硅与氧气反应生成二氧化硅。

Words.Meaning: adj. 相似的，类似的

Examples.English: The two paintings are strikingly similar in style.
Examples.Chinese: 这两幅画的风格惊人地相似。

Examples.English: Her opinion is similar to mine on this issue.
Examples.Chinese: 在这个问题上，她的观点与我的类似。

Examples.English: The experiment yielded results similar to previous studies.
Examples.Chinese: 实验得出的结果与先前研究相似。

Words.Meaning: v. 小口喝，啜饮；n. 一小口（液体）

Examples.English: She sipped her tea slowly, enjoying the warmth.
Examples.Chinese: 她小口啜饮着茶，享受那份温暖。

Examples.English: He took a sip of water before continuing his speech.
Examples.Chinese: 他喝了一小口水，然后继续演讲。

Examples.English: The cocktail was so strong that one sip made her cough.
Examples.Chinese: 这杯鸡尾酒太烈了，她喝了一小口就咳嗽起来。

Words.Meaning: adj. 位于…的，坐落在…的；adj. （人）处于…境地的

Examples.English: The hotel is beautifully situated on a quiet bay.
Examples.Chinese: 这家酒店坐落在一個宁静的海湾，位置极佳。

Examples.English: Having young children places parents in a uniquely situated position of responsibility.
Examples.Chinese: 家有幼童使父母处于一种负有特殊责任的境地。

Examples.English: The factory is situated close to the highway for easy transport.
Examples.Chinese: 工厂坐落于高速公路附近，便于运输。

Words.Meaning: n. 骨骼；骨架；框架；n. （建筑物等的）骨架结构；梗概

Examples.English: The museum displays a dinosaur skeleton.
Examples.Chinese: 博物馆展出了一具恐龙骨架。

Examples.English: The steel skeleton of the building is now complete.
Examples.Chinese: 建筑的钢骨架现已完工。

Examples.English: She outlined the skeleton of her new novel.
Examples.Chinese: 她简述了新小说的框架。

Words.Meaning: adj. 怀疑的，持怀疑态度的

Examples.English: She gave him a skeptical look when he claimed to have seen a UFO.
Examples.Chinese: 当他声称看到UFO时，她投以怀疑的目光。

Examples.English: Scientists remain skeptical about the new theory until more evidence is provided.
Examples.Chinese: 科学家们对新理论持保留态度，除非提供更多证据。

Examples.English: His skeptical nature makes him a sharp critic of conspiracy theories.
Examples.Chinese: 他生性多疑，因此能犀利地批判阴谋论。

Words.Meaning: vi. 跳跃；轻快地移动；vt. 跳过；遗漏（任务、部分等）；n. 跳跃；省略；集装箱（英式英语）

Senses.Definition: 跳跃；省略；集装箱（英式英语）

Examples.English: The children skipped happily across the meadow.
Examples.Chinese: 孩子们欢快地跳过草地。

Examples.English: She decided to skip the boring chapter of the book.
Examples.Chinese: 她决定跳过书中无聊的章节。

Words.Meaning: n. 颅骨，头骨；n. （引申义）头脑，智力

Examples.English: The archaeologist carefully examined the ancient skull.
Examples.Chinese: 考古学家仔细检查了那个古老的头骨。

Examples.English: He has a thick skull and never listens to advice.
Examples.Chinese: 他脑子不开窍，从不听劝。

Examples.English: The impact fractured his skull but he survived.
Examples.Chinese: 撞击使他的颅骨骨折，但他活了下来。

Words.Meaning: adj. 松弛的；懈怠的；n. 松弛部分；淡季；vi. 松懈；怠慢

Examples.English: The rope went slack when the weight was removed.
Examples.Chinese: 移除重物后，绳子变松了。

Examples.English: Don’t slack off during the final project.
Examples.Chinese: 不要在最终项目上懈怠。

Examples.English: Business is usually slack in January.
Examples.Chinese: 一月份通常是生意淡季。

Words.Meaning: n. 掌击；拍打声；vt. 用巴掌打；啪地放下；vi. 拍打；发出拍击声

Examples.English: She gave him a sharp slap across the cheek.
Examples.Chinese: 她狠狠地扇了他一耳光。

Examples.English: The waves slapped against the side of the boat.
Examples.Chinese: 浪花拍打着船身。

Examples.English: He slapped the documents down on the table angrily.
Examples.Chinese: 他生气地把文件啪的一声摔在桌上。

Words.Meaning: v. 猛砍；大幅度削减；n. 砍痕；斜线（/）

Examples.English: He slashed the rope with a knife.
Examples.Chinese: 他用刀砍断了绳子。

Examples.English: The company slashed prices by 50%.
Examples.Chinese: 公司大幅降价50%。

Examples.English: Use a slash to separate options (e.g., and/or).
Examples.Chinese: 用斜线分隔选项（如“和/或”）。

Words.Meaning: n. 屠杀；屠宰；vt. 屠杀；屠宰

Examples.English: The battle resulted in a terrible slaughter of innocent civilians.
Examples.Chinese: 这场战斗导致无辜平民惨遭屠杀。

Examples.English: The government banned the slaughter of endangered species.
Examples.Chinese: 政府明令禁止屠宰濒危物种。

Examples.English: The documentary exposed the cruel conditions of industrial animal slaughter.
Examples.Chinese: 纪录片揭露了工业化屠宰动物的残酷条件。

Words.Meaning: n. 薄片；部分；切片；vt. 切成薄片；切开

Examples.English: She cut a thin slice of bread for the sandwich.
Examples.Chinese: 她为三明治切了一片薄面包。

Examples.English: The pizza was divided into eight equal slices.
Examples.Chinese: 披萨被均分成八块。

Examples.English: He sliced the apple with a sharp knife.
Examples.Chinese: 他用锋利的刀把苹果切成片。

Words.Meaning: adj. 光滑的；熟练的；巧妙的；n. 光滑的表面；油膜；vt. 使光滑；使整洁

Examples.English: The road was slick after the rain.
Examples.Chinese: 雨后路面很滑。

Examples.English: He gave a slick presentation with polished slides.
Examples.Chinese: 他用精美的幻灯片做了一场娴熟的演讲。

Examples.English: The oil spill created a slick on the water's surface.
Examples.Chinese: 泄漏的石油在水面形成了一层油膜。

Words.Meaning: v. 滑动；悄悄移动；n. 滑梯；幻灯片；滑坡

Examples.English: The children love to slide down the snowy hill.
Examples.Chinese: 孩子们喜欢从雪坡上滑下来。

Examples.English: The professor showed a slide of ancient artifacts.
Examples.Chinese: 教授展示了一张古代文物的幻灯片。

Words.Meaning: adj. 轻微的；纤细的；不重要的；vt. 轻视；怠慢；n. 轻蔑；冷落

Senses.Definition: 轻微的；纤细的；不重要的

Examples.English: She felt a slight breeze on her face.
Examples.Chinese: 她感到脸上有一丝微风。

Examples.English: He slighted her by ignoring her question.
Examples.Chinese: 他无视她的问题，以示轻蔑。

Examples.English: The difference between the two versions is very slight.
Examples.Chinese: 两个版本之间的差异微乎其微。

Words.Meaning: vi. 滑倒；滑动；悄悄移动；n. 滑倒；小错误；纸条

Examples.English: She slipped on the icy pavement and fell.
Examples.Chinese: 她在结冰的路面上滑倒了。

Examples.English: Don’t let the opportunity slip through your fingers.
Examples.Chinese: 别让机会从指间溜走。

Examples.English: He wrote his phone number on a slip of paper.
Examples.Chinese: 他把电话号码写在一张纸条上。

Words.Meaning: adj. 滑的；难以抓握的；adj. 狡猾的，不可靠的

Examples.English: The floor was slippery after the rain.
Examples.Chinese: 雨后地板很滑。

Examples.English: He gave a slippery answer to avoid responsibility.
Examples.Chinese: 他给出一个狡猾的回答以逃避责任。

Examples.English: Be careful—the rocks near the river are slippery.
Examples.Chinese: 小心，河边的岩石很滑。

Words.Meaning: n. 标语；口号

Examples.English: The protesters chanted slogans demanding justice.
Examples.Chinese: 抗议者高呼要求正义的口号。

Examples.English: "Just Do It" is one of the most famous advertising slogans.
Examples.Chinese: “Just Do It”是最著名的广告标语之一。

Examples.English: The campaign slogan resonated with young voters.
Examples.Chinese: 这场竞选口号引起了年轻选民的共鸣。

Words.Meaning: n. 斜坡；倾斜面；vi. 倾斜；成斜坡

Examples.English: The skiers raced down the steep slope.
Examples.Chinese: 滑雪者们沿着陡坡疾驰而下。

Examples.English: The roof slopes at a 30-degree angle.
Examples.Chinese: 屋顶以30度角倾斜。

Examples.English: Her handwriting slopes slightly to the right.
Examples.Chinese: 她的笔迹微微向右倾斜。

Words.Meaning: n. 狭缝；投币口；时间段；职位；vt. 插入；安排（时间或位置）

Senses.Definition: 狭缝；投币口；时间段；职位

Examples.English: She inserted a coin into the slot.
Examples.Chinese: 她将硬币投入投币口。

Examples.English: The show has a 30-minute time slot.
Examples.Chinese: 该节目有30分钟的播放时段。

Examples.English: He was slotted into the new team.
Examples.Chinese: 他被安排进了新团队。

Words.Meaning: n. 贫民窟（指城市中拥挤、破败的贫困区域）；vi. 访问或探访贫民窟（旧用法）

Senses.Definition: 贫民窟（指城市中拥挤、破败的贫困区域）
访问或探访贫民窟（旧用法）

Examples.English: The documentary exposed the harsh living conditions in the urban slum.
Examples.Chinese: 这部纪录片揭露了城市贫民窟的恶劣生活条件。

Examples.English: Victorian writers often slummed to gather material for their novels.
Examples.Chinese: 维多利亚时代的作家常探访贫民窟为小说搜集素材。

Examples.English: Efforts to renovate the slum faced resistance from local residents.
Examples.Chinese: 贫民窟改造计划遭到了当地居民的抵制。

Words.Meaning: n. 经济衰退；暴跌；（情绪或状态的）低迷；vi. 大幅下降；突然倒下；萎靡不振

Senses.Definition: 经济衰退；暴跌；（情绪或状态的）低迷
大幅下降；突然倒下；萎靡不振

Examples.English: The economy slumped after the financial crisis.
Examples.Chinese: 金融危机后经济急剧衰退。

Examples.English: She slumped onto the sofa, exhausted.
Examples.Chinese: 她筋疲力尽地瘫倒在沙发上。

Examples.English: His performance slumped in the second half of the game.
Examples.Chinese: 他的表现在比赛下半场大幅下滑。

Words.Meaning: v. 打碎；猛击；彻底击败；n. 破碎声；猛烈撞击；大成功

Senses.Definition: 破碎声；猛烈撞击；大成功

Examples.English: He smashed the window with a hammer.
Examples.Chinese: 他用锤子砸碎了窗户。

Examples.English: The tennis player smashed the ball out of the court.
Examples.Chinese: 网球选手将球猛击出界。

Examples.English: Their new album was a smash hit worldwide.
Examples.Chinese: 他们的新专辑在全球大获成功。

Words.Meaning: vt. 走私（非法运输货物）；vi. 偷偷携带（或运送）

Examples.English: He was arrested for trying to smuggle drugs across the border.
Examples.Chinese: 他因试图走私毒品过境而被捕。

Examples.English: The refugees smuggled themselves into the country in a cargo truck.
Examples.Chinese: 难民们藏在一辆货车里偷渡入境。

Examples.English: She smuggled a note into his pocket without anyone noticing.
Examples.Chinese: 她悄悄把一张纸条塞进他的口袋，无人察觉。

Words.Meaning: n. 小吃；点心；快餐；vi. 吃零食

Examples.English: She grabbed a quick snack between meetings.
Examples.Chinese: 她在会议间隙匆匆吃了点心。

Examples.English: Healthy snacks can boost your energy.
Examples.Chinese: 健康零食能补充能量。

Examples.English: We snacked on popcorn while watching the movie.
Examples.Chinese: 我们看电影时吃了爆米花当零食。

Words.Meaning: vt. 突然抓住；抢夺；n. 抢夺；片段；短暂的时间

Examples.English: The thief snatched her purse and ran away.
Examples.Chinese: 小偷抢了她的钱包就跑。

Examples.English: He managed to snatch a few hours of sleep.
Examples.Chinese: 他设法抓紧时间睡了几小时。

Examples.English: Her speech included a snatch of an old song.
Examples.Chinese: 她的演讲中穿插了一段老歌。

Words.Meaning: vi. 偷偷移动；潜行；vt. 偷偷做（某事）；n. 鬼鬼祟祟的人

Examples.English: He tried to sneak past the guard unnoticed.
Examples.Chinese: 他试图悄悄溜过警卫不被发现。

Examples.English: She sneaked a look at the answers during the test.
Examples.Chinese: 考试时她偷瞄了一眼答案。

Examples.English: Don’t trust him—he’s a sneak who spreads rumors.
Examples.Chinese: 别信他，他是个爱传谣言的鬼祟之人。

Words.Meaning: v. 用鼻子吸气（尤指短促有声地闻或嗅）；n. 吸气声；嗅闻的动作

Senses.Definition: 用鼻子吸气（尤指短促有声地闻或嗅）

Examples.English: The dog sniffed the ground eagerly.
Examples.Chinese: 狗急切地嗅着地面。

Examples.English: She gave a disapproving sniff when she saw the mess.
Examples.Chinese: 看到混乱的场面，她轻蔑地哼了一声。

Examples.English: He caught a sniff of fresh bread from the bakery.
Examples.Chinese: 他闻到面包店飘来的新鲜面包香气。

Words.Meaning: vi. 高飞，翱翔（指鸟类或飞行器）；vi. 急剧上升（指价格、数量等）；vi. 高涨，昂扬（指情绪或抱负）

Senses.Definition: 高飞，翱翔（指鸟类或飞行器）
急剧上升（指价格、数量等）
高涨，昂扬（指情绪或抱负）

Examples.English: The eagle soared above the mountains.
Examples.Chinese: 鹰群在山巅之上翱翔。

Examples.English: Housing prices have soared in the past decade.
Examples.Chinese: 过去十年房价急剧上涨。

Examples.English: Her spirits soared when she received the acceptance letter.
Examples.Chinese: 收到录取通知书时，她的情绪高涨。

Words.Meaning: adj. 清醒的；未醉的；adj. 冷静的；严肃的；vt. 使清醒；使冷静

Examples.English: He stayed sober despite the party's temptations.
Examples.Chinese: 他在聚会上抵住诱惑，保持清醒。

Examples.English: Her sober analysis of the crisis impressed everyone.
Examples.Chinese: 她对危机的冷静分析令众人印象深刻。

Examples.English: The bad news sobered him instantly.
Examples.Chinese: 这个坏消息立刻让他清醒过来。

Words.Meaning: n. 社会学（研究社会结构、关系及发展的学科）

Senses.Definition: 社会学（研究社会结构、关系及发展的学科）

Examples.English: She majored in sociology to understand urban poverty dynamics.
Examples.Chinese: 她主修社会学以理解城市贫困的动态。

Examples.English: Sociology examines how cultures shape individual behaviors.
Examples.Chinese: 社会学研究文化如何塑造个体行为。

Examples.English: His research bridges sociology and political science.
Examples.Chinese: 他的研究连接了社会学与政治学。

Words.Meaning: adj. 庄严的；严肃的；adj. 隆重的（如仪式）

Examples.English: The judge entered the courtroom with a solemn expression.
Examples.Chinese: 法官神情严肃地走进法庭。

Examples.English: They exchanged solemn vows at the wedding.
Examples.Chinese: 他们在婚礼上交换了庄严的誓言。

Examples.English: The memorial service was a solemn occasion.
Examples.Chinese: 这场纪念仪式氛围庄重。

Words.Meaning: n. （英国）初级律师（负责法律咨询、文件准备等非诉讼事务）；n. （美国部分地区）招揽业务者

Senses.Definition: （英国）初级律师（负责法律咨询、文件准备等非诉讼事务）

Examples.English: The solicitor prepared the contract for the property purchase.
Examples.Chinese: 这位初级律师为房产交易准备了合同。

Examples.English: She consulted a solicitor about her inheritance rights.
Examples.Chinese: 她就继承权问题咨询了一位律师。

Examples.English: In some states, door-to-door salesmen are called solicitors.
Examples.Chinese: 在某些州，上门推销员被称为 solicitors。

Words.Meaning: n. 团结（基于共同利益或目标的联合支持）

Senses.Definition: 团结（基于共同利益或目标的联合支持）

Examples.English: The strike demonstrated the workers' solidarity.
Examples.Chinese: 这次罢工展现了工人们的团结。

Examples.English: Global solidarity is crucial in fighting pandemics.
Examples.Chinese: 全球团结对抗击流行病至关重要。

Examples.English: Their solidarity during the crisis inspired the nation.
Examples.Chinese: 他们在危机中的团结激励了整个国家。

Words.Meaning: adj. 独自的；孤独的；adj. 偏僻的；人迹罕至的；n. 隐士；独居者

Examples.English: He led a solitary life in the mountains after retirement.
Examples.Chinese: 退休后，他在山中过着独居生活。

Examples.English: The lighthouse stood solitary on the rocky cliff.
Examples.Chinese: 灯塔孤零零地矗立在岩石峭壁上。

Examples.English: The prisoner was kept in solitary confinement for weeks.
Examples.Chinese: 这名囚犯被单独监禁了数周。

Words.Meaning: n. 独奏；独唱；单人表演；adj. 单独的；独自的；vi. 独奏；独唱

Examples.English: She performed a violin solo at the concert.
Examples.Chinese: 她在音乐会上表演了一段小提琴独奏。

Examples.English: He prefers solo travel to group tours.
Examples.Chinese: 相比跟团游，他更喜欢独自旅行。

Examples.English: The pilot flew solo across the Atlantic for the first time.
Examples.Chinese: 这位飞行员首次独自飞越大西洋。

Words.Meaning: adj. 可溶解的；可解决的

Examples.English: Sugar is soluble in water.
Examples.Chinese: 糖可溶于水。

Examples.English: The conflict proved to be soluble through diplomacy.
Examples.Chinese: 这场冲突可通过外交手段解决。

Examples.English: This chemical compound is only soluble under high pressure.
Examples.Chinese: 这种化合物仅在高压下可溶解。

Words.Meaning: n. 解决方法；解答；n. 溶液；溶解状态

Examples.English: The solution to this math problem requires creative thinking.
Examples.Chinese: 这道数学题的解答需要创造性思维。

Examples.English: Salt forms a clear solution in water.
Examples.Chinese: 盐在水中形成透明的溶液。

Examples.English: Both parties are working toward a peaceful solution.
Examples.Chinese: 双方正在寻求和平解决方案。

Words.Meaning: adj. 酸的；酸味的；adj. 脾气坏的；刻薄的；vi. 变酸；变馊

Examples.English: The milk turned sour after being left out overnight.
Examples.Chinese: 牛奶放置一夜后变酸了。

Examples.English: She gave him a sour look when he interrupted her.
Examples.Chinese: 他打断她时，她投来一个不悦的眼神。

Examples.English: The economic situation has soured relations between the two countries.
Examples.Chinese: 经济状况恶化了两国关系。

Words.Meaning: n. 君主；最高统治者；adj. 至高无上的；拥有主权的

Senses.Definition: 至高无上的；拥有主权的

Examples.English: The sovereign power of the nation resides in its people.
Examples.Chinese: 国家的最高权力属于人民。

Examples.English: Queen Elizabeth II was the sovereign of the United Kingdom for over 70 years.
Examples.Chinese: 伊丽莎白二世女王是英国长达70余年的君主。

Examples.English: A sovereign state has full control over its own laws.
Examples.Chinese: 主权国家对其法律拥有完全掌控权。

Words.Meaning: adj. 宽敞的，广阔的

Examples.English: The living room is spacious enough for a grand piano.
Examples.Chinese: 客厅宽敞得足以放下一架三角钢琴。

Examples.English: She admired the spacious skies of the countryside.
Examples.Chinese: 她赞叹乡村辽阔的天空。

Examples.English: The new office building features spacious corridors and open-plan areas.
Examples.Chinese: 新办公楼以宽敞的走廊和开放式区域为特色。

Words.Meaning: n. 跨度；一段时间；范围；vt. 横跨；跨越；持续

Examples.English: The bridge spans the river with a single arch.
Examples.Chinese: 这座桥以单拱结构横跨河流。

Examples.English: Her career spanned three decades.
Examples.Chinese: 她的职业生涯跨越了三十年。

Words.Meaning: vi. 闪烁，闪耀；焕发活力；n. 闪光；活力，生气

Examples.English: Her eyes sparkled with excitement.
Examples.Chinese: 她的双眼因兴奋而闪闪发亮。

Examples.English: The diamond sparkled under the spotlight.
Examples.Chinese: 钻石在聚光灯下熠熠生辉。

Examples.English: He always adds sparkle to our meetings with his humor.
Examples.Chinese: 他的幽默总为我们的会议注入活力。

Words.Meaning: n. 专家；专科医生

Examples.English: She is a specialist in ancient Greek history.
Examples.Chinese: 她是古希腊历史领域的专家。

Examples.English: You should consult a heart specialist for this condition.
Examples.Chinese: 这种情况你应该咨询心脏专科医生。

Examples.English: The company hired a cybersecurity specialist to protect its data.
Examples.Chinese: 公司聘请了一位网络安全专家来保护数据。

Words.Meaning: n. 专业领域；特长；n. （某地或某人的）特色产品/服务

Senses.Definition: （某地或某人的）特色产品/服务

Examples.English: Her specialty is medieval European history.
Examples.Chinese: 她的专业领域是中世纪欧洲史。

Examples.English: This restaurant’s specialty is handmade pasta.
Examples.Chinese: 这家餐厅的特色菜是手工意大利面。

Examples.English: The doctor chose cardiology as his specialty.
Examples.Chinese: 这位医生选择心脏病学作为他的专业。

Words.Meaning: n. （生物分类学）物种；n. 种类；类型

Examples.English: This forest is home to over 200 species of birds.
Examples.Chinese: 这片森林是200多种鸟类的栖息地。

Examples.English: The scientist discovered a new species of deep-sea fish.
Examples.Chinese: 科学家发现了一种新的深海鱼类物种。

Examples.English: We need to protect endangered species from extinction.
Examples.Chinese: 我们需要保护濒危物种免于灭绝。

Words.Meaning: adj. 明确的；具体的；adj. 特有的；特定的

Examples.English: The doctor gave specific instructions for the medication.
Examples.Chinese: 医生给出了具体的用药说明。

Examples.English: This tool is specific to woodworking.
Examples.Chinese: 这种工具专用于木工。

Examples.English: Can you be more specific about your requirements?
Examples.Chinese: 你能更明确地说明你的需求吗？

Words.Meaning: n. 规格；详细说明；n. （产品或工程的）技术要求

Examples.English: The contract includes detailed specifications for the materials.
Examples.Chinese: 合同中包含材料的详细规格说明。

Examples.English: The software specification was approved by the development team.
Examples.Chinese: 开发团队通过了该软件的技术要求文档。

Examples.English: Always check the product specifications before purchasing.
Examples.Chinese: 购买前务必核对产品规格参数。

Words.Meaning: n. 壮观景象；奇观；n. （复数）眼镜

Examples.English: The sunset over the mountains was a breathtaking spectacle.
Examples.Chinese: 山间的日落是一场令人屏息的奇观。

Examples.English: He adjusted his spectacles before reading the newspaper.
Examples.Chinese: 他戴上眼镜调整位置，开始读报。

Examples.English: The parade turned the city streets into a vibrant spectacle.
Examples.Chinese: 游行将城市街道变成了活力四射的盛景。

Words.Meaning: n. 观众；旁观者

Examples.English: The stadium was packed with excited spectators.
Examples.Chinese: 体育场挤满了兴奋的观众。

Examples.English: As a mere spectator, he avoided getting involved in the debate.
Examples.Chinese: 作为纯粹的旁观者，他避免卷入争论。

Examples.English: The art exhibition attracted thousands of spectators daily.
Examples.Chinese: 艺术展每天吸引数千名参观者。

Words.Meaning: n. 光谱；范围，系列

Examples.English: The prism separated sunlight into a spectrum of colors.
Examples.Chinese: 棱镜将阳光分离成一系列色彩。

Examples.English: The study covers a broad spectrum of opinions.
Examples.Chinese: 这项研究涵盖了广泛的观点范围。

Examples.English: Autism exists on a spectrum of severity.
Examples.Chinese: 自闭症存在于一个严重程度不一的谱系中。

Words.Meaning: vi. 推测；猜测；vi. 投机（尤指金融投资）

Examples.English: Scientists can only speculate about the origins of the universe.
Examples.Chinese: 科学家只能推测宇宙的起源。

Examples.English: He made his fortune by speculating in the stock market.
Examples.Chinese: 他通过股市投机积累了财富。

Examples.English: It’s useless to speculate without concrete evidence.
Examples.Chinese: 没有具体证据的猜测是无用的。

Words.Meaning: n. 香料；调味品；vt. 加香料；增添趣味

Examples.English: Cinnamon and nutmeg are common spices in baking.
Examples.Chinese: 肉桂和肉豆蔻是烘焙中常用的香料。

Examples.English: She spiced the soup with a pinch of cumin.
Examples.Chinese: 她往汤里加了一撮孜然调味。

Examples.English: His jokes added spice to the dull meeting.
Examples.Chinese: 他的笑话为枯燥的会议增添了趣味。

Words.Meaning: n. 脊柱；脊椎；n. （植物的）刺；（动物的）刺状结构；n. （书籍的）书脊

Examples.English: She injured her spine in a car accident.
Examples.Chinese: 她在车祸中伤到了脊柱。

Examples.English: Cacti have sharp spines to protect themselves.
Examples.Chinese: 仙人掌用尖刺保护自己。

Examples.English: The title was printed in gold on the spine of the book.
Examples.Chinese: 书名用金色印在书的书脊上。

Words.Meaning: n. 螺旋；螺旋形物体；持续恶化/增长的过程；adj. 螺旋形的；盘旋的；vi. 盘旋上升/下降；持续恶化/增长
